item.title: Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek Ahead of US Visit: “No Problem Speeding Up OPCON Transfer” (방미 앞둔 안규백 국방 장관 “전작권 전환 속도 내는 것 문제없다”)
item.description:
Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek expressed his determination for an early return of wartime operational control (OPCON) on the 10th, stating, “We have prepared systematically, stably, and consistently.” <<> Minister Ahn made these remarks while meeting with reporters at Incheon International Airport before departing for the United States to attend the ROK-U.S. Defense Ministers’ Meeting, saying, “I believe speeding up the OPCON transition is largely unproblematic. South Korean and U.S. authorities made significant progress in 2015 under a conditions-based agreement regarding the OPCON transition.” <<> On his first visit to the United States since taking office as minister, Ahn will stay in the U.S. from the 11th (local time) through the 14th, including a meeting with U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, and will meet with the Acting Secretary of the Navy, the Chairman of the Senate Armed Services Committee, and the Chairman of the Seapower Subcommittee. <<> Minister Ahn and Secretary Hegseth are expected to focus discussions on OPCON transition and issues related to nuclear-powered submarines during their meeting. The Lee Jae-myung administration has expressed its determination to complete the second stage (Full Operational Capability) verification for OPCON transition this year and finalize the return of OPCON by 2028. However, U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Brunson revealed a difference in perception at a congressional hearing on the 22nd of last month (local time), mentioning the first quarter of 2029 as the target timeline for meeting OPCON transition conditions. Minister Ahn said, “During last year’s ROK-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting (SCM), we agreed to finalize the year of (OPCON transition) at this year’s year-end SCM. This will also be one of the key agenda items this time.” <<> Regarding delays in discussions on the ROK-U.S. nuclear submarine construction project, Minister Ahn stated, “If the U.S. side provides us with some fuel support, I believe going through the (construction) process would not be a significant issue,” and indicated that the first round of negotiations could take place within the first half of this year. In addition, the issue of sharing North Korea-related intelligence, which was partially suspended following Unification Minister Chung Dong-young’s remarks about “North Korea’s nuclear facilities in Kusong, North Pyongan Province,” is also expected to be discussed. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (안규백 국방부 장관이 10일 전시작전통제권(전작권)과 관련해 “체계적, 안정적, 일관적으로 준비해 왔다”며 조기 환수 의지를 밝혔다.)

item.title: Busan's 'North Gap Battle' Begins: Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon Hold Rival Opening Ceremonies; Ha Jung-woo Enters the Fray an Hour Later (부산 ‘북갑대전’ 개막…박민식·한동훈 ‘맞불’ 개소식, 하정우 1시간 뒤 ‘참전’)
item.description:
"The conservatives who fight among themselves, the self-righteous conservatives, and the outdated conservatives must now step aside." (Park Min-sik, People Power Party candidate for Busan North Gap) (“내부총질하는 보수, 유아독존 보수, 구태 보수는 이제 물러가야 한다.”(박민식 국민의힘 부산 북갑 후보))

"I will win in Buk-gu and surely make it to the Blue House." (Han Dong-hoon, independent candidate for Busan North Gap) (“북구에서 승리해 반드시 청와대로 가겠다.”(한동훈 무소속 부산 북갑 후보))

At 2 PM on the 10th, the Deokcheon-dong area of Busan's Buk-gu was ablaze with a three-way battle among conservative opposition candidates. Park Min-sik of the People Power Party and independent Han Dong-hoon, both running in the Busan North Gap by-election, held their campaign office opening ceremonies on the same day and time, separated by just 600 meters—a 10-minute walk—across Deokcheon-dong's Youth Street. (10일 오후 2시. 부산 북구 덕천동 일대는 보수 야권 후보들의 세 대결로 뜨겁게 달아올랐다. 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 박민식 국민의힘 후보와 한동훈 무소속 후보가 덕천동 젊음의 거리를 사이에 두고 불과 600m, 걸어서 10분 거리에서 한날한시 선거사무소 개소식을 열면서다.)

At the Daehyang Building in Buk-gu, where Park's ceremony took place, the full leadership of the People Power Party turned out to showcase their strength. Attendees included Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk, Floor Leader Song Eon-seok, Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong, 24 incumbent lawmakers, and Busan Mayor Park Hyung-jun. Some 5,000 supporters of Park (according to the organizers) packed the venue, lending their support. (박 후보 개소식이 열린 북구 대향빌딩에는 국민의힘 지도부가 총출동해 세를 과시했다. 장동혁 대표, 송언석 원내대표, 정희용 사무총장을 포함해 현역 의원 24명과 박형준 부산시장이 참석했다. 박 후보 지지자 5000여명(주최 쪽 추산)도 빼곡히 들어서 힘을 보탰다.)

Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk, seemingly targeting Han, said, "The conservative party has fallen on hard times because of internal divisions," adding, "It shouldn't be someone who sows seeds of conflict and division, but someone like Park Min-sik, who steadfastly upholds conservatism, who should rebuild the conservative party." He continued, "We need not someone who seeks to exploit the People Power Party, but Park Min-sik, who can truly love the People Power Party." (장동혁 대표는 한 후보를 겨냥한 듯 “보수정당이 어렵게 된 것은 우리끼리 분열해서”라며 “갈등과 분열의 씨앗을 뿌린 사람이 아니라, 박민식처럼 굳건하게 보수를 지킨 사람이 보수정당을 새롭게 만들어야 한다”고 말했다. 이어 “국민의힘이라는 정당을 이용하려는 사람이 아니라 국민의힘을 진정 사랑할 수 있는 박민식이 필요하다”고 덧붙였다.)

Near the Hanjin Building in Buk-gu, where Han's ceremony was held, about 10,000 supporters (according to the organizers) gathered. In attendance were former lawmaker Seo Byung-soo, who left the People Power Party to serve as honorary campaign committee chair, and Jo Gap-je, CEO of Jo Gap-je Dot Com. However, pro-Han Dong-hoon lawmakers from the People Power Party did not attend. Han had dissuaded them from coming after the People Power Party leadership threatened to discipline any pro-Han lawmakers who attended the ceremony. Supporters began gathering around his campaign office about two hours before the event. Most were dressed in "Monami fashion"—white tops and black bottoms. (한 후보 개소식이 열린 북구 한진빌딩 근처에는 한 후보 지지자 1만여명(주최 쪽 추산)이 모였다. 이 자리에는 국민의힘을 탈당해 명예선대위원장을 맡은 서병수 전 의원과 조갑제 조갑제닷컴 대표도 참석했다. 다만 국민의힘 친한동훈계 의원들은 참석하지 않았다. 한 후보는 국민의힘 지도부가 개소식에 참석하는 친한계 의원을 징계하겠다고 벼르자 이들의 참석을 만류했다. 그의 선거 사무소 주변에는 개소식이 열리기 2시간 정도 전부터 지지자들이 모여들었다. 이들은 대부분 흰색 상의에 검정색 하의를 입은 ‘모나미 패션’이었다.)

Han stated, "I thought about inviting powerful people to show off, but I prepared this ceremony as a festival with the residents of Buk-gu," adding, "I will win in Buk-gu and surely make it to the Blue House." Chung Hyung-keun, a former lawmaker from the Grand National Party (the predecessor of the People Power Party) and chair of Han's fundraising committee, who has been criticized for his involvement in torture investigations during his time at the National Security Planning Agency, did not attend, citing 'health reasons.' The physical clashes between supporters of Park and Han that some had feared did not occur. (한 후보는 “힘센 사람들을 불러 자랑할까도 생각해봤지만, 북구 주민과의 축제로 개소식을 준비했다”며 “북구에서 승리해 반드시 청와대로 가겠다”고 말했다. 국가안전기획부 시절 고문 수사 논란으로 비판받은 후원회장 정형근 전 한나라당(국민의힘의 전신) 의원은 ‘건강상의 이유’로 참석하지 않았다. 일부에서 우려했던 박 후보와 한 후보 지지자들 사이의 물리적 충돌은 일어나지 않았다.)

Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party candidate for the Busan North Gap by-election, also showed he was not backing down from the verbal sparring. Ha held his opening ceremony an hour later, at 3 PM, at the former lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo's congressional office in Gupo-dong, Buk-gu. Ha declared, "Through the invincible fleet of Buk-gu development led by Lee Jae-myung, Jeon Jae-soo, and Ha Jung-woo, I will connect budgets, systems, and people to accelerate the progress of Buk-gu." (하정우 더불어민주당 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보도 신경전에 빠지지 않는 모습이었다. 하 후보는 이들보다 1시간 뒤인 오후 3시 북구 구포동에 있는 옛 전재수 의원 국회의원 사무소에서 개소식을 열었다. 하 후보는 “이재명-전재수-하정우로 이어지는 북구 발전의 무적함대를 통해 예산과 제도, 사람을 연결해 북구의 시간을 앞당기겠다”고 했다.)

Attending the ceremony were Jeon Jae-soo, the Busan mayoral candidate serving as fundraising chair; Kim Young-choon, former Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, serving as honorary campaign committee chair; and Assemblyman Kim Young-jin, deputy chair of the talent recruitment committee. Rep. Jung Cheong-rae, who sparked controversy with the 'Oppa scandal,' attended Jeon Jae-soo's campaign office opening the previous day but did not attend Ha's ceremony. (개소식에는 후원회장을 맡은 전재수 부산시장 후보와 명예선대위원장을 맡은 김영춘 전 해양수산부 장관, 인재영입위원회 부위원장 김영진 의원 등이 참석했다. ‘오빠 논란’으로 설화를 빚은 정청래 대표는 전날 전재수 후보 선거사무소 개소식에 참석했으나 이날 하 후보 개소식에는 참석하지 않았다.)

The race in Busan North Gap is a tight contest. In a poll conducted by SBS and polling agency Ipsos from the 1st to the 3rd, support stood at 38% for Ha, 26% for Park, and 21% for Han. Meanwhile, a survey by Busan MBC and Han-gil Research during the same period showed Ha at 34.3%, Park at 21.5%, and Han at 33.5% (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). (부산 북갑은 백중세다. 에스비에스(SBS)-여론조사기관 입소스가 지난 1∼3일 실시한 여론조사에서 지지도는 하 후보 38%, 박 후보 26%, 한 후보 21% 순이었다. 같은 기간 부산문화방송(MBC)-한길리서치 조사에서는 하 후보 34.3%, 박 후보 21.5%, 한 후보 33.5%로 나타났다(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조).)

Busan/Reporters Jo Hee-yeon, Kim Wan, and Go Han-sol choh@hani.co.kr (부산/조희연 김완 기자, 고한솔 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Election Committee Launches…Jeong Cheong-rae: “We Must Judge the Forces That Dream of Another Insurrection” (민주당 선대위 출범…정청래 “다시 내란 꿈꾸는 세력 심판”)
item.description:
With 24 days left until the June 3 local elections, the Democratic Party of Korea launched its election strategy committee on the 10th, centering on the key phrase “restoring the nation,” and fully shifted into local election campaign mode. <<> Jeong Cheong-rae, who serves as the general co-chair of the election committee, said at the launch ceremony held at the National Assembly, “In this election, we must surely judge the arrogant forces that dream of another insurrection through the ‘Yoon Again’ nominations.” He added, “Today, we begin the great journey of the ‘Republic of Korea National Restoration Election Strategy Committee’ to fulfill the historic mission of our time.” <<> Representative Jeong stated, “This election is a golden opportunity to support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration and complete balanced national development.” He said, “The regional governors, mayors, provincial councilors, and municipal councilors nominated by the Democratic Party will create local governments that work as effectively as Lee Jae-myung.” He further emphasized, “When the Lee Jae-myung government and local governments operate in seamless alignment, like meshing gears, we can also achieve local-led growth through the ‘5 Mega-Regions and 3 Special Self-Governing Provinces’ strategy.” <<> The composition of the election committee focused on strengthening local organizations. Representative Jeong explained, “This election committee is structured as a ‘field-tight’ organization that approaches the people more closely and swiftly.” He added, “The central election committee was formed with a minimal number of people who can incorporate diverse voices, and heavyweight figures, including former and current supreme council members, have been assigned to oversee each region.” <<> Efforts were also made to secure diversity through the recruitment of outside figures. Former North Chungcheong Governor Lee Si-jong, WHO advisor on climate, AI, and health Ahn Seon-ha, Daegu-born surgeon Geum Hee-jung (known as the “eldest daughter of TK” during the last presidential campaign), and naturalized Korean citizen from Myanmar Lee Bona were named as co-chairs of the election committee alongside floor leader Park Chan-dae. Representative Jeong described it as “a grand unity and comprehensive inclusion-type election committee that gathers not only the Democratic Party’s talent but also new figures who embody the people’s aspirations.” He explained, “It reflects the Democratic Party’s will to be a large vessel that embraces the voices of all people, transcending class, gender, region, and generation.” <<> Supreme council members Lee Un-ju, Hwang Myeong-seon, Kang Deuk-gu, Lee Seong-yoon, Moon Jeong-bok, Park Ji-won, and Park Gyu-hwan will serve as co-chairs of the election committee. Actor Lee Won-jong has been appointed as the “Alley-Alley Election Committee Chair,” overseeing regional campaigns. <<> Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거를 24일 앞둔 10일 ‘국가 정상화’를 열쇳말로 내건 선거대책위원회를 출범하고 지방선거 체제로 본격 전환했다.)

item.title: Why the Lee Jae-myung Administration is Confident: "The Surge in Housing Prices is Different from the Moon Jae-in Administration" (“집값 급등, 문 정부 때와 달라” 이재명 정부 자신하는 이유는)
item.description:
As the heavy capital gains tax system on multiple homeowners resumes today (June 10) after four years, the government assesses that the rampant housing price hikes seen under the Moon Jae-in administration will not be repeated. There is particular optimism that the market will see an increase in new listings through measures such as exempting non-resident single homeowners from land transaction permits and reforming the permanent capital gains tax benefits previously granted to rental business operators. (다주택자에 대한 양도세 중과 제도가 4년 만인 10일 재개된 가운데, 정부는 문재인 정부 때와 같은 집값 폭등세는 재현되지 않을 것이라고 판단하고 있다. 특히 비거주 1주택자에 대한 토지거래허가 예외 적용과 임대사업자에게 주어진 영구적 양도세 혜택 개편 등을 통해 시장에 추가 매물이 나올 것으로 기대하는 분위기다.)

The government's expectation of a different outcome from the past stems from its handling of a "tax card" designed to encourage property listings. This aligns with remarks made by Kim Yong-beom, head of the Cheong Wa Dae policy office, during a press briefing on June 4, where he stated, "President Lee Jae-myung has previewed a rationalization of housing taxes by differentiating them by type—such as multiple homeowners, non-resident single homeowners, and ultra-high-value properties—making the situation different from that under the Moon Jae-in administration." Previously, the Moon administration had imposed a 10-percentage-point surtax for two homeowners and a 20-percentage-point surtax for three homeowners in targeted adjustment areas through the August 2, 2017 measures, followed by additional 10-percentage-point increases for each in the July 10, 2020 measures. After the implementation of the July 10 measures in June 2021, an analysis indicated market side effects, including a lock-in effect on listings, leading to phenomena such as the so-called "one prime property" trend. ( 정부가 과거와 다른 양상을 기대하는 근거는 매물을 유도할 ‘세제 카드’를 만지작거리고 있기 때문이다. 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 지난 4일 기자간담회에서 “이재명 대통령이 다주택자, 비거주 1주택, 초고가 등 유형별로 차등화해 주택에 대한 세제를 합리화한다는 걸 예고했다”며 “그게 (문재인 정부와) 다른 상황”이라고 밝힌 것도 같은 맥락이다. 앞서 문재인 정부는 2017년 8·2 대책을 통해 조정대상지역 내 2주택자 중과세율을 10%포인트, 3주택자 중과세율을 20%포인트 가산했고, 2020년 7·10 대책 때 각각 10%포인트씩 추가 가산했다. 7·10 대책 시행일(2021년 6월) 이후 시장에서는 매물 잠김으로 이른바 ‘똘똘한 한채’ 현상 등 부작용이 나타났다는 분석이 나온 바 있다.)

The first item under discussion is the reduction of long-term holding special deduction benefits for non-resident single homeowners. President Lee lent weight to this direction on April 24 in a post on X (formerly Twitter), stating, "To properly protect the residence of single homeowners, it is appropriate to reduce deductions for non-resident holding periods and increase deductions for resident holding periods accordingly." Currently, a single homeowner can receive up to 40% based on holding period and up to 40% based on residency period for long-term holding special deductions, allowing a maximum of 80% of capital gains to be deducted. Observations suggest a reshuffling to emphasize residency periods. However, the government remains cautious about adjusting holding taxes, such as property tax and comprehensive real estate tax. A Cheong Wa Dae official told The Hankyoreh on June 10, "As holding taxes are a last resort, we will make decisions based on market conditions." ( 가장 먼저 거론되는 것이 비거주 1주택자의 장기보유특별공제 혜택 축소 카드다. 이 대통령은 지난달 24일 엑스(X)에 “1주택자의 주거를 제대로 보호하려면 비거주 보유 기간에 대한 감면을 축소하고, 그만큼 거주·보유 기간에 대한 감면을 늘리는 것이 맞다”며 이런 방향에 힘을 실었다. 현재 1주택자는 보유 기간에 따라 최대 40%, 거주 기간에 따라 최대 40%의 장기보유특별공제를 받아 최대 80%까지 양도차익을 공제받을 수 있는데 이를 거주 기간 중심으로 재편할 것이란 관측이 나온다. 다만 재산세·종합부동산세 등 보유세 손질에는 신중한 태도다. 청와대 관계자는 10일 한겨레에 “보유세는 최후의 수단인 만큼 시장 상황을 보고 판단할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Additionally, the administration plans to encourage new listings through measures such as exempting non-resident single homeowners from land transaction permits. Minister of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Kim Yoon-deok wrote on Facebook this day, "We intend to review exemption measures for land transaction permits for non-resident single homeowners and whether offering permanent capital gains tax reductions to rental business operators is appropriate. Although there are significant concerns about listing lock-downs after the resumption of heavy capital gains taxes, the People's Sovereignty Government will be different." ( 아울러 비거주 1주택자에 대한 토지거래허가 예외 적용 등을 통해 추가 매물을 유도한다는 방침이다. 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관은 이날 페이스북에 “비거주 1주택자 등에 대한 토지거래허가 예외 방안과 임대사업자에게 영구적 양도세 감면 혜택을 주는 것이 적정한지 검토할 예정”이라며 “양도세 중과 재개 후 매물 잠김 우려가 크지만, 국민주권정부는 다를 것”이라고 적었다.)

He further emphasized, "The Lee Jae-myung administration is not merely focused on stabilizing the real estate market but is pursuing fundamental institutional reforms out of a pressing recognition that without removing barriers to income classes and regional mobility, the future and unity of South Korea cannot be secured." ( 그러면서 그는 “이재명 정부는 단순 부동산 시장 안정 관점이 아니라 소득계층과 지역 간 계층이동의 장벽 해소 없이는 대한민국의 미래와 통합을 담보할 수 없다는 절박한 인식하에서 근본적인 제도개혁을 추진 중”이라고 강조했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Government, Regarding the NAMUHO Fire: "Unidentified Flying Object Caused External Impact" ([속보] 정부, 나무호 화재 “미확인 비행물체가 외부 충격”)
item.description:
<<>> The government announced on the 10th that the fire that occurred on the HMM NAMUHO while it was anchored in the Strait of Hormuz was due to an external impact. ()

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated on the evening of the same day, "A joint government investigation team conducted a field investigation on the 8th regarding the HMM NAMUHO anchored in the Strait of Hormuz," and added, "The investigation confirmed that an unidentified flying object struck the stern of the HMM vessel." However, it is seen as being caused by an 'unidentified flying object' rather than underwater drones or floating mines, which had been suggested by some. ( 정부가 호르무즈 해협에서 정박 중이던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호에서 발생한 화재 원인이 외부 충격 때문이라고 10일 발표했다. )

Earlier, a seven-member investigation team, including investigators from the Korean Maritime Safety Tribunal and forensic experts from the National Fire Agency, began on-site investigations on the 8th, the day after the NAMUHO arrived at the Dubai port shipyard, and concluded the investigation on this day. The team analyzed the VDR (Voyage Data Recorder) and CCTV footage, which serve as the ship's black box, and also listened to the crew's testimonies. ( 외교부는 이날 저녁 “호르무즈 해협에 정박중이던 에이치엠엠 나무호 관련 정부 합동 조사단이 현장 조사를 지난 8 실시했다”며 “조사 결과 미상의 비행체가 에이치엠엠 선박 선미를 타격한 것으로 확인했다”고 발표했다. 다만 일각에서 제기됐던 수중 드론이나 부유 기뢰는 아닌 ‘미확인 비행물체’에 의한 충격으로 보고 있다.)

A Cheong Wa Dae official also said on that day, "We have received the preliminary results of the field investigation and are currently reviewing and evaluating them with relevant agencies," and added, "We will provide an answer regarding the cause of the NAMUHO fire after a review and evaluation of the field investigation results by relevant agencies." ( 앞서 해양안전심판원 조사관과 소방청 감식 전문가 등 조사단 7명은 나무호가 두바이항 조선소에 도착한 다음 날인 지난 8일부터 현장 조사를 벌였고, 이날 조사를 마무리했다. 조사단은 사고 당시 나무호의 블랙박스격인 브이디알(VDR) 시시티브이(CCTV) 영상을 분석하고, 선원들의 증언도 청취했다.)

As the cause of the NAMUHO explosion and fire has been found to be from an external impact, Cheong Wa Dae and the government are expected to maintain a cautious stance until they further confirm the attacker and the circumstances. There are particular concerns that a hasty announcement could lead to diplomatic and security repercussions amid heightened tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. ( 청와대 관계자도 이날 “1차적인 현장조사 결과를 받았으며, 관계기관 간 검토 및 평가 중”이라며 “나무호 화재의 원인은 현장조사 결과에 대한 관계기관 간 검토 및 평가를 거쳐 답변드리겠다”고 말했다.)

The Iranian government maintains that it has nothing to do with the NAMUHO ship explosion and fire. On the 6th, the Iranian Embassy in South Korea issued a statement saying, "We strongly reject and firmly deny all claims that the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran were involved in the incident related to the damage sustained by the South Korean ship in the Strait of Hormuz." ( 나무호 폭발·화재 원인이 외부 충격에 의한 것으로 조사된 만큼, 청와대와 정부는 공격 주체와 경위 등을 추가 확인할 때까지 신중한 태도를 유지할 것으로 보인다. 특히 호르무즈해협 긴장이 고조된 상황에서 섣부른 발표가 외교·안보 파장으로 이어질 가능성을 우려하는 분위기다. )

Previously, an explosion and fire occurred in the engine room of the NAMUHO, which was anchored in waters near the United Arab Emirates (UAE) inside the Strait of Hormuz, around 8:40 p.m. on the 4th. Immediately after the incident, the government gave weight to the possibility of an attack based on statements from crew members, but later showed caution, saying it could not be certain of an attack. On the 6th, National Security Office Director Suh Hoon said, "Initially, the possibility of an attack was raised, but after further reviewing the information, it seems the attack is not certain," and added, "There was no flooding or tilting of the ship." ( 이란 정부는 나무호 선박 폭발·화재가 자신들과 관련 없다는 태도를 유지하고 있다. 주한이란대사관은 지난 6일 “호르무즈해협에서 한국 선박이 입은 피해와 관련된 사건에 이란 공화국의 군이 개입했다는 모든 주장을 단호하게 거부하고 강력히 부인한다”는 내용의 성명을 발표하기도 했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 앞서, 호르무즈해협 안쪽 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에 정박해 있던 나무호 기관실에서 폭발과 화재가 발생한 건 지난 4일 오후 8시40분께다. 정부는 사건 직후 선원 등 진술을 토대로 피격 가능성에 무게를 뒀지만, 이후 피격을 확신할 수 없다며 신중한 태도를 보였다. 위성락 국가안보실장은 지난 6일 “초기에 피격 가능성이 거론됐는데, 정보를 추가 검토해보니 피격이 확실하지 않은 것 같다”며 “침수나 배의 기울임은 없었다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Foreign Ministry “Summons Iranian Ambassador to Korea… Explains HMM NAMU Fire Investigation Results” (외교부 “주한이란대사 불러…나무호 화재 조사결과 설명”)
item.description:
After the government officially confirmed on the 10th that the fire that broke out on the HMM NAMU vessel anchored in the Strait of Hormuz was caused by an impact from an external aircraft, it summoned Iranian Ambassador to Korea Saeed Koozechi to the foreign ministry building. (정부가 10일 호르무즈해협에서 정박 중이던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호에서 발생한 화재 원인이 외부 비행체의 충격 때문이라고 공식 확인한 뒤, 사이드 쿠제치 주한이란대사를 외교부 청사로 불렀다.)

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Park Il explained the summoning of Ambassador Koozechi to the ministry building, stating, “We are communicating with relevant countries based on the facts confirmed so far, and the government plans to take necessary measures going forward. Since Iran is one of the relevant countries, the Iranian ambassador visited the ministry building to be briefed on our investigation results.” Ambassador Koozechi is scheduled to meet with First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-ju to discuss the issue. Spokesperson Park Il added, “We are not presuming the perpetrator of the attack at this point.” (박일 외교부 대변인은 쿠제치 대사를 외교부 청사로 부른 데 대해 “현재까지 확인된 사실 관계를 바탕으로 관련국과 소통하고 있으며, 정부는 앞으로 필요한 대응을 취해 나갈 예정”이라면서, “이란은 관련국에 해당되기 때문에 우리 조사 결과를 설명하기 위해 주한이란대사가 청사를 방문한 것”이라고 밝혔다. 쿠제치 대사는 박윤주 외교부 1차관과 만나 이 문제를 논의한다. 박일 대변인은 “현재 공격의 주체를 예단하지 않는다”고 말했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: HMM NIMU Hit Confirmed by ‘External Aircraft’, Complicating Government Response (나무호 ‘외부 비행체’ 피격 확인, 복잡해진 정부 대응)
item.description:
The government has officially confirmed that the explosion and fire on the HMM NIMU, which was anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, was caused by a strike from an external aircraft. While the government has emphasized a cautious approach regarding the identity of the attacker, if confirmed to be Iran’s attack, it is highly likely to pose a dilemma in relations with both Iran and the United States. (정부가 호르무즈해협에 정박해있던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호의 폭발·화재 원인이 외부 비행체의 타격 탓이라고 공식 확인했다. 정부는 공격 주체에 대해 신중한 태도를 강조했지만, 이란의 공격으로 확인될 경우 대이란, 대미 관계에서 난제를 안게 될 가능성이 높다.)

Park Il, Vice Spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, held an emergency briefing on the evening of the 10th and announced that a precise on-site investigation by a government investigation team found that “an ‘unidentified aircraft’ struck the stern of the HMM NIMU.” The team confirmed through hull damage and CCTV footage from the NIMU that, around 15:30 on the 4th (20:30 Korean time), two unidentified aircraft struck the port-side ballast tank outer plating of the HMM NIMU’s stern twice at approximately one-minute intervals, causing a fire. Immediately after the incident, the government had emphasized the possibility of an attack based on testimony from the crew and others, but National Security Office Director Suh Wook took a cautious stance on the 6th, stating “the attack is not certain.” Spokesperson Park explained, “At the time, it was because the crew or nearby ships could not identify the breach.” <<> Spokesperson Park repeatedly emphasized, “We do not prejudge the identity of the attacker.” However, the likelihood of it being an Iranian attack has increased. On the same day, First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo summoned Iranian Ambassador to South Korea Saeed Koozechi to the foreign ministry building and explained the investigation results. After the meeting, Ambassador Koozechi, with a perplexed expression, told reporters, “We talked about general issues regarding the attack. Please direct your questions to the Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs,” and left the building. The Iranian Embassy in Seoul had stated on the 6th, “We firmly reject and deny any claims that Iranian forces were involved in the incident concerning the damage to the Korean ship.” <<> The presidential office held a working-level meeting of the National Security Council (NSC) on the same day, with relevant ministries including the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries participating, to discuss the results of the investigation into the NIMU incident and countermeasures. The government plans to conduct a detailed analysis of the aircraft engine debris recovered from the scene to make a final determination on whether the aircraft was a drone or a missile, and whether it is linked to Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. <<> If the detailed investigation reveals an Iranian attack, significant repercussions are expected. <<> The government has been actively engaged in diplomacy with Iran, including sending a special envoy from the foreign minister and maintaining a local embassy, to ensure the safety of 26 Korean ships stranded in the Strait of Hormuz. Nevertheless, if it turns out that Iran attacked our ship and then denied it, a response will be unavoidable. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, “We will thoroughly determine the cause and pursue all possible measures, including cooperation with the international community, to prevent recurrence.” <<> <<> There is potential for increased U.S. pressure on South Korea to join operations to open the Strait of Hormuz. <<> The strike on the NIMU occurred amid heightened tensions after U.S. President Donald Trump announced the launch of “Project Freedom” to assist in the evacuation of ships trapped in the Strait of Hormuz and Iran attempted to prevent U.S. forces from entering the strait. Immediately after the incident, President Trump, claiming the NIMU was attacked by Iran after acting alone, pressured South Korea to contribute to opening the strait. Although Trump suspended Project Freedom, the U.S. State Department separately proposed participation in a multinational coalition, the “International Maritime Security Construct” (IMSC), which South Korea has been reviewing. Spokesperson Park Il stated, “We will explain the investigation results to the U.S. side,” and added, “We are also closely reviewing the issue of participating in the U.S. initiative for the IMSC.” <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr ( 박일 외교부 대변인은 10일 저녁 긴급 브리핑을 열고 정부조사단의 현장 정밀 조사 결과 “‘미상의 비행체’가 에이치엠엠 나무호의 선미를 타격한 것으로 확인했다”고 발표했다. 조사단은 지난 4일 15시30분(한국시각 저녁 20시30분)께 미상의 비행체 2기가 HMM 나무호 선미 좌현 평형수 탱크 외판을 약 1분 간격으로 2차례 타격해 화재가 일어났음을 선체 손상과 나무호 CCTV 화면 등을 통해 확인했다. 정부는 사건 직후 선원 등 진술을 토대로 피격 가능성에 무게를 뒀지만 위성락 국가안보실장은 지난 6일 “피격이 확실치 않다”며 신중한 태도를 취했다. 박 대변인은 “당시에는 선원이나 인근 선박을 통해서 파공을 식별하지 못하였기 때문”이라고 설명했다. )

item.title: President Lee on Non-Resident Single Homeowner Exception to Land Transaction Permit Zone: "Claims of Allowing Gap Investment Are 'Forced Criticism'" (이 대통령, 비거주 1주택 토허제 예외에 “갭투자 허용 주장은 ‘억까’”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 11th regarding the government's consideration of applying an exception to the land transaction permit zone for non-resident single homeowners to allow home sales, saying, "Claims that this is effectively allowing gap investment are close to 'forced criticism' (unreasonably tearing down)." (이재명 대통령이 11일 정부가 비거주 1주택자에게 토지거래허가구역 예외 규정을 적용해 집 매매를 허용하는 방안을 검토하는 것을 두고 “사실상 갭투자 허용이라는 주장은 ‘억까’(억지로 깎아내리기)에 가깝다”고 말했다.)

The President shared an article titled 'To Prevent Transaction Cliff... Opening Path for Non-Resident Single Home Sales' on X (formerly Twitter). The article reported that the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport is considering a plan to allow non-resident single homeowners in land transaction permit zones to sell their rented homes, while deferring the mandatory move-in requirement for homebuyers without a home for a certain period, which the article claimed effectively allows gap investment for homeless individuals. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 ‘거래 절벽 막으려… 비거주 1주택 매매 길 튼다’라는 제목의 기사를 공유했다. 국토교통부가 토지거래허가구역에서 비거주 1주택자가 세 낀 집을 팔 경우, 무주택 매수자의 실거주 의무를 일정 기간 유예해 주는 방안을 검토하고 있는데, 이는 무주택자의 갭투자를 사실상 허용하는 것이라는 내용의 기사였다.)

The President refuted this, detailing the policy the government will announce. The President stated, "To ensure fairness, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport is limiting buyers to homeless individuals, granting single homeowners with tenants the same selling opportunity as multi-homeowners. Buyers are allowed to move in only after the remaining lease period of the existing tenant expires, with that period capped at a maximum of two years." The President added, "This gives opportunities to single homeowners who cannot sell because they cannot move in within 4-6 months due to lease periods, while ensuring buyers must pay the deposit and move in personally within two years." (이 대통령은 이를 반박하며 정부가 발표할 정책 내용을 자세히 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “국토교통부가 형평성 보장을 위해 다주택자와 동일하게, 세입자가 있는 1주택자에게도 매도할 기회를 주기 위해 매수인은 무주택자로 한정하고, 매수인은 기존 임차인의 잔여 임차기간이 지난 후에 입주할 수 있게 허용하되 그 기간을 최고 2년을 넘지 못하게 한다”고 밝혔다. 이어 이 대통령은 “임차기간 때문에 4~6개월 내 입주할 수 없어 매각하지 못하는 1주택자들에게도 기회를 주되, 매수인은 2년 이내에는 반드시 보증금을 내 주고 직접 입주하도록 했다”고 덧붙였다.)

The President then remarked, "Requiring full payment, including the deposit, within the remaining lease period, and at most within two years, claiming this allows gap investment seems excessive." (그러면서 이 대통령은 “잔여 임대기간, 그것도 최대 2년 이내에 보증금 포함 매매대금 전액을 지급해야 하는데, 이걸 가지고 갭투자를 허용하는 것이라고 하는 건 과해 보인다”고 말했다.)

The President also said, "Escaping the real estate republic is an essential task for our country's normalization and sustainable development. How many would profit if real estate speculation recurs? I request your cooperation." (이 대통령은 또 “부동산 공화국 탈출은 우리나라의 정상화와 지속 발전을 위한 필수 과제”라며 “부동산 투기가 재발하면 몇이나 득을 보겠냐. 협조를 요청한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘Crash’ Stage Fall Next to Han Dong-hoon… Han Says “I Didn’t Notice” (한동훈 옆에서 ‘꽈당’ 무대 추락…한 “인지 못 했다”)
item.description:
Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, running in the by-election for the Busan Buk-gu Gap National Assembly seat, faced controversy for appearing indifferent when a camera operator fell off the stage during his campaign press conference, leading him to refute the claims, stating he “didn’t notice the cameraman fall.” (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 한동훈 무소속 후보가 출마 기자회견 당시 카메라 기자가 무대에서 추락했음에도 무신경했다는 논란이 일자 “기자가 넘어지는 것을 인지하지 못했다”고 반박했다.)

The incident occurred on the 9th at a small park near Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Busan, during Han’s campaign press conference. According to video posted on Han’s official YouTube channel, a camera operator from a broadcaster stepped backward to film Han as he ascended the stage, falling off the stage in the process. (사고는 지난 9일 부산 북구 구포시장 근처 쌈지공원에서 열린 한 후보의 출마 기자회견 현장에서 발생했다. 한 후보 공식 유튜브 채널에 올라온 영상을 보면, 한 방송사의 카메라 기자가 무대 위로 올라오는 한 후보를 찍기 위해 뒷걸음질을 치다 무대 아래로 떨어졌다.)

At the moment of the fall, Han was waving and looking in the opposite direction, but he immediately turned his head toward the side where the cameraman had fallen. After that, Han looked toward the fallen cameraman for about 4 seconds, which led to the spread of the video on YouTube and social media (SNS), sparking criticism that Han was indifferent despite being aware of the accident. (떨어지는 순간 한 후보는 반대쪽을 바라보며 손을 흔들고 있었지만 직후 카메라 기자가 떨어진 쪽으로 고개를 돌렸다. 이후에도 한 후보는 4초가량 카메라 기자가 떨어진 쪽을 바라봤는데 이 때문에 유튜브와 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에서는 관련 영상이 확산하며 한 후보가 사고가 난 것을 알면서도 무신경했다는 비판이 일었다.)

Some netizens criticized him, saying, “The cameraman fell, but he didn’t even pretend to be surprised, let alone show concern,” and “He just looked on without moving a muscle.” (일부 누리꾼들은 “카메라 기자가 추락했는데 걱정은커녕 놀라는 척도 안 한다”, “쳐다만 보고 미동도 안 한다”고 비판했다.)

As the controversy grew, Han’s camp refuted the claims on the 10th, stating, “Candidate Han did not notice the cameraman falling, and this can be clearly confirmed in the footage.” They added, “Immediately after the incident, Candidate Han checked the situation with the host, and after receiving a response that it was ‘fine,’ he proceeded with the press conference.” Han’s camp further stated, “Afterward, we also separately communicated about the cameraman’s condition and confirmed the situation.” They added, “Malicious dissemination of false information during the election period is subject to strict punishment, and we plan to take legal action.” (논란이 커지자 한 후보 쪽은 10일 “한 후보는 해당 기자가 넘어지는 것을 인지하지 못했으며 이는 영상에서 충분히 확인 가능하다”고 반박했다. 이어 “상황 발생 직후 한 후보는 사회자에게 상황을 확인했으며, 현장에서 ‘괜찮다’는 답변을 받은 뒤 기자회견을 진행했다”고 밝혔다. 한 후보 쪽은 “이후에도 기자분의 상태와 관련해 별도로 소통하며 상황을 확인했다”며 “선거기간 악의적인 허위 사실 유포는 엄벌 대상이며, 법적 조치 예정”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Are they saying a UFO attacked the HMM Naju?"... People Power Party goes on the offensive over the government's cautious response. (“UFO가 나무호 공격했단 건가”…국힘, 정부 신중 대응에 총공세)
item.description:
Regarding the government's announcement that the explosion and fire on the HMM Naju, which was anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, were caused by a strike from an external aircraft, the People Power Party criticized, "The initial investigation results from the government's investigation team are missing two crucial letters: 'Iran'." They are pushing back against the government's cautious stance on identifying the attacker. (정부가 호르무즈해협에 정박해있던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호의 폭발·화재 원인이 외부 비행체의 타격이라고 밝힌 데 대해, 국민의힘은 “(정부조사단의) 1차 조사 결과에 반드시 들어가야 할 두 글자가 빠져 있다. 바로 ‘이란’이다”고 비판했다. 정부가 공격 주체에 대해 신중한 태도를 취하는 것에 대해 반발하고 나선 것이다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at the party's Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the morning of the 11th, "Iran's state broadcaster has already reported that they targeted a Korean ship," adding, "The perpetrator is confessing, but the victim is denying it." He continued, "Even after reviewing the CCTV footage, they call it an unidentified aircraft. Was there an attack by an alien UFO?" and added, "The money that the Lee Jae-myung regime handed over to Iran might have come back as a drone that attacked our ship." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 11일 오전 국회에서 열린 당 최고위원회의에서 “이미 이란 국영방송사가 한국 선박을 표적으로 삼았다고 보도했다”며 “때린 놈이 자백하는데도 맞은 사람이 아니라고 하는 것”이라고 말했다. 이어 “시시티브이(CCTV) 영상을 확인하고도 미상의 비행체라고 한다. 외계인의 유에프오(UFO·미확인 비행체) 공격이라도 있었다는 건가”라며 “이재명 정권이 이란에 갖다 바친 돈이 우리 선박을 공격한 드론으로 돌아왔을지도 모른다”고 덧붙였다.)

The previous day, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Park Il stated multiple times, "It has been confirmed that an 'unidentified aircraft' struck the stern of the HMM Naju," but emphasized, "We are not making any premature judgments about the identity of the attacker." The Iranian Embassy in Seoul had stated on the 6th, "We firmly reject and deny any claims that Iranian forces were involved in the incident related to the damage suffered by the Korean ship." (전날 박일 외교부 대변인은 “‘미상의 비행체’가 에이치엠엠 나무호의 선미를 타격한 것으로 확인했다”면서도 “공격의 주체에 대해서는 예단을 하지 않는다”고 여러 차례 강조했다. 주한이란대사관은 지난 6일 “한국 선박이 입은 피해와 관련된 사건에 이란군이 개입했다는 모든 주장을 단호하게 거부하고 부인한다”고 한 바 있다.)

Floor leader Song Eon-seok also said at the meeting, "Denying the possibility of an attack simply because there was no flooding or capsizing is an attitude that prioritizes downplaying the situation over public safety. The government must transparently disclose the details of the Naju attack incident and its response process to the public, and immediately take practical safety measures and withdrawal plans to protect our ships and citizens." (송언석 원내대표도 회의에서 “침수나 전복이 없었다는 이유만으로 피격 가능성을 부정하는 것은 국민 안전보다 상황 축소에 급급한 움직임만 보이는 태도”라며 “정부는 나무호 피격 사건 경위와 대응 과정을 국민들에게 투명히 공개하고, 우리 선박과 국민 보호를 위한 실질적인 안전 조치와 철수 대책 마련에 즉각 나서야 할 것”이라고 말했다.)

The People Power Party appears to be using the Naju attack incident as a basis for an offensive against the ruling party. The previous day, National Assembly Defense Committee Chairperson Seong Il-jong wrote on Facebook, "Mr. President, who said, 'If you touch a Korean, you'll be ruined'! What will you do now?" adding, "Due to the extreme incompetence of the Lee Jae-myung administration, they either genuinely didn't know about the attack, or they knew but tried to cover it up at all costs ahead of the election. Either way, it's a very serious problem." Additionally, members of the National Assembly's Defense Committee and Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee from the People Power Party have demanded that the Democratic Party of Korea hold emergency question-and-answer sessions at the standing committee level. (국민의힘은 나무호 피격 사건을 고리로 대여 공세에 나서는 모양새다. 전날 성일종 국회 국방위원장은 페이스북에 “‘한국인 건들면 패가망신’이라는 대통령님! 이제 어떻게 하시겠습니까”라며 “이재명 정부의 엄청난 무능으로 정말 피격당한 것을 모르고 있었거나, 알고 있었음에도 선거를 앞둔 지금 어떻게든 은폐하려 했었던 것이다. 둘 중 어느 쪽이어도 매우 심각한 문제”라고 썼다. 또 국민의힘 소속 국회 국방위 위원들과 외교통일위원회 위원들은 상임위 차원의 긴급 현안질의를 개최할 것을 더불어민주당에 요구하고 나섰다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Min-sik Candidate: On Yoon Seok-yeol's Martial Law, "It's Still on Trial...Historical Evaluation Requires a Long View" (박민식 후보, 윤석열 계엄에 “재판 중…역사적 평가 길게 봐야”)
item.description:
Park Min-sik, the People Power Party candidate for the by-election for Busan Buk-gu's National Assembly seat, said on the 11th regarding former President Yoon Seok-yeol's December 3 emergency martial law: "The trial hasn't even concluded yet, and historical evaluation should be taken with a long-term perspective." (박민식 국민의힘 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보가 11일 윤석열 전 대통령의 12·3 비상계엄에 대해 “아직 재판도 끝나지 않은 상태인데, 역사적 평가는 긴 호흡을 가지고 봐야 한다”고 말했다.)

Appearing on MBC Radio's "Kim Jong-bae's Focus," Candidate Park stated, "Looking at the overall public opinion, it's not a case where 100% say decisively, 'This is an insurrection.'" He added, "As the trial is ongoing, labeling those who opposed the impeachment as anti-democratic forces is not only excessive but also inappropriate." (박 후보는 이날 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’에 출연해 “일반 국민들의 여론을 종합적으로 보면 일도양단식으로 ‘이것이 내란이다’라고 100% 하는 게 아니다”라며 “재판이 진행되고 있는데, 탄핵에 반대한 사람들을 반민주 세력이라고 하는 태도는 과할 뿐 아니라 맞지도 않다”고 말했다.)

Regarding his election competitor, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon's appointment of former lawmaker Jeong Hyeong-geun—a former public security prosecutor with alleged torture ties—as his campaign chairman, Park said, "When I first started as a lawmaker in Buk-gu, (former lawmaker Jeong) was a three-term lawmaker and a member of the party's Supreme Council. He was identified as the top priority for removal from the conservative camp by young reformists like myself, Park Hyung-joon, and Won Hee-ryong, all of whom are lawyers and former special investigation prosecutors. Whether Han appoints him as campaign chairman is entirely his choice, but it's a very outdated move." (그는 선거 경쟁자인 한동훈 무소속 후보가 고문 의혹이 있는 공안검사 출신 정형근 전 의원을 후원회장으로 위촉한 것에 대해 “제가 국회의원을 북구에서 시작할 당시 (정 전 의원은) 3선 의원으로 당 최고위원을 하고 있었는데, 젊은 특수부 검사 출신 변호사인 저와 박형준·원희룡 등 소장 개혁파들이 보수에서 퇴출돼야 할 1순위로 지목한 분”이라며 “한 후보가 그분을 후원회장으로 하고 안 하고는 본인의 자유의사이지만, 아주 구태스러운 것”이라고 말했다.)

Candidate Park previously staged a sleep-in protest in front of the Constitutional Court during the impeachment proceedings against former President Yoon last year, and he took the stage at an anti-impeachment rally to praise Yoon, calling him an "eternal president." (박 후보는 지난해 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵 정국 당시 헌법재판소 앞에서 노숙 투쟁을 하고, 탄핵 반대 집회 연단에 올라 “영원한 대통령”이라며 윤 전 대통령을 추어올린 바 있다.)

item.title: Citizen Yu Chung-won, who blocked a martial law armored vehicle, appointed as co-chair of the Democratic Party’s joint standing election committee (계엄 장갑차 막아선 유충원씨, 민주당 공동상임선대위원장 임명)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 11th that it has appointed citizen Yu Chung-won, who blocked an armored vehicle during the December 3 insurrection, as co-chair of the joint standing election committee of the Central Election Countermeasures Committee. (더불어민주당이 12·3 내란사태 당시 장갑차를 막아섰던 시민 유충원씨를 중앙선거대책위원회 공동상임선대위원장으로 임명한다고 11일 밝혔다.)

At a meeting of the Central Election Countermeasures Committee held in Chuncheon, Gangwon Province, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae stated, “Today, we have appointed an additional co-chair,” and introduced him by saying, “You may have seen the photo of a citizen blocking an armored vehicle during the December 3 emergency martial law—he is the person in that photo.” (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 이날 강원 춘천에서 열린 중앙선거대책위원회 회의에서 “오늘 (공동상임선대위원장) 한 분을 추가 위촉했다”며 “12·3 비상계엄 당시 장갑차를 막아선 시민 사진을 보셨을 텐데, 바로 그 주인공”이라고 소개했다.)

Representative Jeong explained, “While lawmakers, party officials, and aides worked hard to pass the motion for its repeal, it was the ordinary citizens who played a huge role in allowing lawmakers to secure the time to do so. The citizens who overcame the December 3 insurrection are the protagonists of this election committee. It was through the efforts and strength of citizens that we could lift the emergency martial law, and on this path toward normalizing the country, we appointed (Mr. Yu) to convey that we will examine public sentiment from the perspective of citizens.” (정 대표는 “국회의원과 당직자, 보좌관 등도 해제안 의결을 위해 많이 노력했지만, 국회의원들이 시간을 확보할 수 있었던 것은 일반 시민의 힘이 매우 컸다”며 “12·3 내란을 극복했던 시민들이 이번 선대위의 주인공이다. 시민의 노력과 힘으로 비상계엄을 해제할 수 있었고, 국가정상화로 가는 이 길에서 시민의 시선으로 민심을 살피겠다고 전달하기 위해 (유씨를) 위촉했다”고 설명했다.)

Chairman Yu said, “On December 3, 2024, I saw the illegal martial law on the news. Seeing military helicopters land at the National Assembly reminded me of the scene in 1980 during the Gwangju Democratization Movement when helicopters landed on Geumnam-ro, so I headed straight to the National Assembly without looking back. Many citizens had gathered to stop the illegal martial law, and seeing that, I truly felt that the owners of the Republic of Korea are the people.” He added, “We overcame the illegal insurrection, and the Lee Jae-myung People’s Sovereignty Government was born. I will do my best to carry forward and develop the values of the People’s Sovereignty Government through a landslide victory in the June 3 local elections.” (유 위원장은 “2024년 12월3일 방송을 통해 불법 계엄의 모습을 봤다. 국회에 군용 헬기가 착륙하는 모습을 보고 1980년 광주민주화운동 당시 금남로에 헬기가 착륙하는 장면이 떠올라 뒤도 안돌아보고 국회로 향했다”며 “불법 계엄을 저지하기 위해 많은 국민이 모여 있었고, 그 모습에 대한민국의 주인은 국민이라는 사실을 실감했다”고 말했다. 그는 “불법 내란을 극복하고 이재명 국민주권정부가 탄생했다”며 “6·3지방선거 압승을 통해 국민주권정부의 가치를 계승하고 발전할 수 있게 최선을 다하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Donghak Peasant Revolution is the Root of Democracy… We Will Build a Warm Community" (이 대통령 “동학농민혁명은 민주주의의 뿌리…따뜻한 공동체 만들 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated at the national commemoration of the Donghak Peasant Revolution on the 11th, "I pay deep respect to the resounding cries, courage, and noble sacrifices of the participants of the Donghak Peasant Revolution, who sowed the precious seeds of democracy on this land." (이재명 대통령이 11일 동학농민혁명 국가기념식에서 “이 땅에 고귀한 민주주의 씨앗을 뿌린 동학농민혁명 참여자들의 우렁찬 함성과 용기, 그리고 고귀한 희생 앞에 깊은 경의를 표한다”고 밝혔다.)

The President made these remarks in a congratulatory speech read on his behalf by Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Choi Hwi-young at the 132nd anniversary national commemoration of the Donghak Peasant Revolution, hosted by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism at the National Museum of Korea in Yongsan-gu, Seoul. (이 대통령은 이날 문화체육관광부가 서울 용산구 국립중앙박물관에서 주최한 제132주년 동학농민혁명 국가기념식에서 최휘영 문화체육관광부 장관이 대독한 축사를 통해 이렇게 말했다.)

President Lee emphasized, "The government of the people's sovereignty is also aligned with the Great Harmony World (Daedong Sesang) that the farmers dreamed of in 1894. The government will devote all its efforts to creating a warm community where the people, as the true masters of the nation, enjoy their rightful rights and share the fruits of growth together." The following is the full text of President Lee's congratulatory speech. (이 대통령은 “국민주권 정부 또한 1894년 농민들이 꿈꾸던 대동세상과 맞닿아 있다”라며 “정부는 국민이 나라의 진정한 주인으로서 정당한 권리를 누리고 성장의 결실을 함께 나누는 따뜻한 공동체를 만들기 위해 온 힘을 다하겠다”고 강조했다. 다음은 이 대통령 축사 전문.)

Respected citizens,
Dear families of the Donghak Peasant Revolution participants and officials of nationwide Donghak Peasant Revolution organizations, (존경하는 국민 여러분,
동학농민혁명 참여자 유족과 전국의 동학농민혁명 단체 관계자 여러분,)

I pay deep respect to the resounding cries, courage, and noble sacrifices of the participants of the Donghak Peasant Revolution, who sowed the precious seeds of democracy on this land. (이 땅에 고귀한 민주주의의 씨앗을 뿌린 동학농민혁명 참여자들의 우렁찬 함성과 용기, 그리고 고귀한 희생 앞에 깊은 경의를 표합니다.)

This year marks the 132nd anniversary of the Donghak Peasant Revolution. The Donghak Peasant Revolution, which awakened the truth that the people are the foundation and masters of the nation, was the great first step of Korean democracy. The spirit of the Donghak Peasant Revolution, which dreamed of a world where people live with dignity and a Great Harmony World where everyone prospers, while resisting unjust power, has become an unquenchable lamp in our hearts. (동학농민혁명이 일어난 지 올해로 132주년이 되었습니다. 백성이 나라의 근본이자 주인임을 일깨운 동학농민혁명은 대한민국 민주주의의 위대한 첫 발걸음이었습니다. 사람답게 사는 세상, 모두가 잘사는 대동세상을 꿈꾸며 부당한 권력에 항거하던 동학농민혁명의 정신은 우리의 가슴 속에 꺼지지 않는 등불이 되었습니다.)

This spirit, which has been continuously passed down through the Independence Revolution, the April 19 Revolution, and the May 18 Democratization Movement to the 'Candlelight Revolution' and the 'Revolution of Light,' has become the source that has blossomed today's Republic of Korea into a 'model democratic nation' recognized by the world. (독립혁명과 4.19혁명, 5.18 민주화 운동을 거쳐 ‘촛불혁명’과 ‘빛의 혁명’으로 면면히 이어져 온 그 정신은, 오늘날 대한민국을 세계가 주목하는 ‘모범적 민주주의 국가’로 활짝 꽃피운 원천이 되었습니다.)

The government of the people's sovereignty is also aligned with the Great Harmony World that the farmers dreamed of in 1894. The government will devote all its efforts to creating a warm community where the people, as the true masters of the nation, enjoy their rightful rights and share the fruits of growth together. (국민주권정부 또한 1894년 농민들이 꿈꾸던 대동세상과 맞닿아 있습니다. 정부는 국민이 나라의 진정한 주인으로서 정당한 권리를 누리고 성장의 결실을 함께 나누는 따뜻한 공동체를 만들기 위해 온 힘을 다하겠습니다.)

Together with the people, we will build a Republic of Korea that is a 'nation where everyone prospers together,' with no marginalized neighbors and where everyone enjoys fair opportunities, and a 'nation where the people are the masters,' achieving a more developed and mature democracy that transcends the disparities we face. (소외된 이웃 없이 누구나 공정한 기회를 누리며 ‘다 함께 잘사는 나라’, 우리가 마주한 격차를 뛰어넘어 더 발전되고 성숙한 민주주의를 이루는 ‘국민이 주인인 나라’ 대한민국을 국민 여러분과 함께 만들어 가겠습니다.)

Once again, I sincerely congratulate the meaningful 132nd anniversary commemoration of the Donghak Peasant Revolution. I hope health and happiness fill the homes of all who have joined us here. (다시 한번, 뜻깊은 제132주년 동학농민혁명 기념식을 진심으로 축하합니다. 함께 해주신 모든 분들의 가정에 건강과 행복이 깃들길 소망합니다.)

Thank you. (고맙습니다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government Secures 'Drone Debris' from HMM Ruby's Hull…Iran Says "No Position" (정부, 나무호 선체서 ‘드론 잔해’ 확보…이란 쪽 “입장 없다”)
item.description:
The government has confirmed on the 11th that it secured drone debris from the hull of the HMM Ruby, which caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz. (정부가 호르무즈해협에서 화재가 발생한 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호 선체에서 드론 잔해를 확보한 것으로 11일 확인됐다.)

Multiple diplomatic sources revealed on the 11th, "Drone debris was secured from the Ruby's hull and will soon be brought to South Korea for analysis." (복수의 여권 소식통은 11일 “나무호 선체에서 드론 잔해를 확보했고, 곧 한국으로 가져와 감식할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

The previous day, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced, "At around 3:30 PM on May 4 (local time), two unidentified aircraft struck the port side ballast tank shell plating of the Ruby's stern twice, at approximately one-minute intervals." However, while the government discovered drone engine debris on the hull, it noted that further confirmation is needed to determine whether a drone itself struck the Ruby or whether it was a missile launched by a drone, among other possibilities. (전날 외교부는 “5월4일 3시30분께(현지시각) 미상의 비행체 2기가 나무호 선미 좌현 평형수 탱크 외판을 약 1분 간격으로 두 차례 타격했다”고 발표했다. 다만 정부가 선체에서 발견한 것은 드론 엔진 잔해지만, 실제 나무호를 타격한 것이 드론 자체인지, 드론이 투하한 미사일 등인지는 추가 확인이 필요하다고 보고 있다.)

The government plans to conduct additional analysis once the drone engine debris found on the Ruby arrives in South Korea. A seven-member investigation team, including experts from the Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal and the National Fire Agency, has returned after completing on-site investigations at Dubai Port, and the drone debris will be brought into South Korea separately through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Considering the need for detailed analysis, it may take several days to obtain precise results on the cause. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated the previous day, "Since the subject of the attack has not yet been identified, we will proceed with further investigations." (정부는 나무호에서 발견된 드론 엔진 잔해 등이 한국에 들어오는 대로 추가 분석을 할 예정이다. 해양안전심판원과 소방청 전문가 등 7명으로 구성된 조사단은 두바이항에서 현지 조사를 마치고 귀국했으며, 드론 잔해는 외교부를 통해 별도로 한국으로 들여올 예정이다. 정밀 감식까지 고려하면 정확한 원인 분석 결과가 나오기까지는 수일이 걸릴 전망이다. 외교부는 전날 “피격 주체에 대해선 아직 확인되지 않았기 때문에 추가 조사를 진행할 예정”이라고만 밝혔다.)

Regarding the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' announcement, Iran has been tight-lipped. When asked by The Hankyoreh for its position on the South Korean Foreign Ministry's statement, the Iranian Embassy in South Korea said, "At this point, the Iranian Embassy has no position on this matter. We will inform you if there are any additional official statements." (이 같은 외교부 발표에 대해 이란 쪽은 말을 아끼고 있다. 주한이란대사관은 한국 외교부 발표에 대한 입장을 묻는 한겨레 질문에 “현재로서는 해당 사안에 대해 이란대사관의 입장은 없다. 추가 공식 입장이 있을 경우 알려드리겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "I saw it as an opportunity and lifted the land transaction permit zone"... Jung Won-oh: "That's an admission you took a risk without proper consideration" (오세훈 “기회로구나, 토허제 풀어”…정원오 “고민 않고 모험했다는 자인”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, stated on the 11th regarding last year's lifting and subsequent reimposition of the land transaction permit zone in Gangnam: "It was a one- to two-month hiccup." (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 지난해 강남권 토지거래허가구역을 해제했다가 재지정한 것에 대해 “한두달 정도의 해프닝”이라고 11일 말했다.)

During a debate hosted by the Korea Broadcasting Journalists' Club at MBN Media Center, the candidate described the lifting and reimposition of the land transaction permit zone last year as "my only real estate blunder." (오 후보는 이날 엠비엔(MBN)미디어센터에서 열린 한국방송기자클럽 토론회에서 지난해 토허제 해제와 재지정에 대해 “제 유일한 부동산 실책”이라고 밝혔다.)

He explained: "At the time, the decision to lift the land transaction permit zone in Gangnam came when an analysis report indicated that the market was cooling excessively. I thought, 'If we lift it for Jamsamdaecheong (Jamsil in Songpa-gu, and Samseong, Daechi, Cheongdam in Gangnam-gu), now is the perfect opportunity,' and acted on that judgment. However, the market reacted very sensitively, and within just over a month, we restored it. Thanks to that, housing prices fell again." (그는 “당시 강남지역 토지거래허가 구역을 해제한 것은 ‘지나치게 싸늘하게 식어간다’는 분석보고서가 나올 때였다”며 “거기에 민감하게 대응하기 위해 ‘잠삼대청’(송파구 잠실, 강남구 삼성·대치·청담)을 푼다면 지금이 기회로구나' 하고 판단해서 풀었다. 그런데 시장이 굉장히 민감하게 대응해 불과 한 달 남짓 반에 원상복구를 했고, 그 덕분에 다시 (집값이) 떨어졌다”고 했다.)

Oh further claimed: "They are politically attacking me as if I am solely responsible for the continued failure of housing policies. Citizens will surely remember." (오 후보는 그러면서 “마치 지금까지 이어지는 부동산 정책 실패의 원인이 저한테 있는 것처럼 정치적인 공격을 하고 있다. 시민 여러분은 다 기억하고 계실 것”이라고 주장했다.)

In response, the election campaign committee of Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, issued a statement criticizing: "At that time, due to Oh's incompetence, housing supply in Seoul had plummeted. By lifting the land transaction permit zone in Gangnam—where expectations and pent-up demand were concentrated—housing price increases in Gangnam hit a seven-year high within a month. The outcome was that, amid the government's concerns at the time, Oh reversed his decision within a month and actually expanded the zone to a wider area." The statement added, "Oh dismissing this as a hiccup is no different from admitting he took a risk without properly considering even basic risks." (이에 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보 선거대책위원회는 논평을 내어 “당시 오 후보의 무능으로 서울 주택공급이 급감한 상황에서, 기대 심리와 대기 수요가 몰려있는 강남권 토허구역을 해제해 한달 만에 강남 집값 상승률이 7년 만에 최고치를 찍었다”며 “당시 정부의 우려에 오 후보가 한달 만에 결정을 번복하고 오히려 더 넓은 지역으로 토허구역을 확장한 것이 이 사태의 결말”이라고 반박했다. 그러면서 “오 후보가 이걸 해프닝으로 치부하는 것은, 상식 수준의 리스크도 제대로 고민해보지 않고 모험을 했다는 자인이나 다름없다”고 덧붙였다. )

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam apologizes: 'Sewol special committee is a waste of tax money' remark 'hurt the bereaved families' (김용남 “‘세월호 특조위 세금 낭비’ 발언 유가족에 상처” 사과)
item.description:
Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the by-election for the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly seat, apologized for his past remarks calling the April 16 Sewol Ferry Disaster Special Investigation Committee a "waste of tax money," stating, "Regardless of my intention, I acknowledge that those comments left an indelible wound on the hearts of the bereaved families." He also referred to his experience serving as a spokesperson for Yoon Seok-yeol, the People Power Party presidential candidate during the 21st presidential election, as a "mistake." (김용남 더불어민주당 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거 후보가 과거 4·16 세월호 참사 특별조사위원회를 가리켜 “세금 낭비”라고 한 자신의 말에 대해 “제 의도와 상관없이 그 발언이 유가족분들의 가슴에 지울 수 없는 상처를 남겼음을 인정한다”며 사과했다. 21대 대선 때 윤석열 국민의힘 대통령 후보 캠프 대변인으로 활동한 경력에 대해서도 “과오”라고 했다.)

Candidate Kim issued this apology on Facebook on the 11th in a post titled "I sincerely apologize for my shortcomings." He wrote, "First, I bow my head and apologize to the bereaved families of the Sewol ferry disaster," adding, "At the time, I failed to fully grasp how deeply my remarks would wound the hearts of those who lost their beloved children and families. Before that pain, which nothing in the world can fully comfort, my words were far too immature." He continued, "My belief that the bereaved families deserve an exhaustive investigation without any taboo zones and generous support has remained unchanged since right after the disaster, and it still does. However, I was immature in that my expression of my views regarding the activities of the Sewol Special Committee created room for misunderstanding." <<> In a 2015 radio interview while serving as a lawmaker for the Saenuri Party, Candidate Kim had said, "It is urgent to review the budget for the Sewol Special Committee, which has been virtually wasting taxpayers' money without doing anything throughout its entire activity period," and "The Special Committee has almost filled its 120-member roster with people who have past so-called activist experience or are involved in that scene, and now they absurdly plan to investigate the president's seven-hour whereabouts on the day of the Sewol sinking." <<> Meanwhile, Candidate Kim also clarified his stance on serving as a spokesperson for the Yoon Seok-yeol campaign during the 21st presidential election. He wrote, "The bond from working together as prosecutors about 20 years ago, and the memories from that time, clouded my judgment. However, after realizing the truth, I have been at the forefront, grabbing the microphone and focusing on exposing the misdeeds of the Yoon Seok-yeol administration." He added, "Especially faced with this insurrection crisis, I have raised my voice decisively. From immediately after the declaration of martial law, my stance—that 'this is clearly an insurrection, and Yoon Seok-yeol must be punished and impeached as the ringleader of this insurrection'—has been no different from the democratic and progressive bloc by even an inch. My shouting louder than anyone else for the necessity of impeachment was, perhaps, a desperate effort to wash away my mistake of having been with him, even briefly." <<> He continued, "The fact that I served as a spokesperson for the Yoon Seok-yeol presidential campaign will remain a major stain on my life, but I will never deny or try to erase it. I will take that mistake as a painful lesson and, spending the rest of my political life with you, take the lead and devote myself to making the Republic of Korea a stronger bastion of democracy." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김 후보는 11일 페이스북에 ‘저의 부족함에 대해 깊이 사과드립니다’라는 제목의 글을 올려 이렇게 사과했다. 그는 “먼저 세월호 유가족분들께 고개 숙여 사죄드린다”며 “당시 제 발언이 사랑하는 자식과 가족을 잃은 유가족분들의 가슴에 얼마나 깊은 상처를 남길지 충분히 헤아리지 못했다. 세상 그 무엇으로도 온전히 위로할 수 없는 그 아픔 앞에, 제 표현은 너무나 미숙했다”고 했다. 이어 “유가족분들께 성역 없는 진상 규명과 아낌없는 지원이 당연히 이뤄져야 한다는 생각에는 참사 직후부터 변함이 없었고 지금도 마찬가지이지만, 세월호 특조위의 활동과 관련한 저의 뜻을 전달하는 데 있어서 오해의 소지를 만들었다는 점에서 미숙했다”고 적었다.)

item.title: [News Dive] People Power Party Turns ‘Maruho’ Incident into Political Fodder Again ([뉴스 다이브] ‘나무호’ 또 정쟁화하는 국힘)
item.description:
Cast: Former Lawmaker Kim Jong-dae, Senior Deputy Spokesperson Im Se-eun of the Democratic Party, Reporter Kwak Woo-sin from OhmyNews, Reporter Ha Eo-young from the Hankyoreh Political Team. Host: Ko Hyun-joon. From May 10, heavy capital gains tax on multi-home owners resumes after four years. Government: “Maruho explosion—external attack”… Cautious in naming the attacker. U.S.-Iran ceasefire negotiations at a standstill… Trump: “Iran could attack for two more weeks.” People Power Party: “Was the Maruho incident caused by a UFO?”… Politicizing again. [Exclusive] Jang Dong-hyuk tells U.S. media “Major problems in Korea-U.S. relations”… Stirring up conflict with a contributed article. “Yoon again… I helped make him party leader…” Jeon Han-gil feeling slighted by Jang Dong-hyuk? item.title: [Breaking News] Wi Sung-lac "Namuho Attack Strongly Condemned...Identifying the Perpetrator and Taking Action" ([속보] 위성락 “나무호 피격, 강력 규탄…공격 주체 찾아내 조치”)
item.description:
National Security Advisor Wi Sung-lac stated on the 11th regarding the fire on the HMM NAMUHO being an "external attack," saying, "Our government's position is that attacks on civilian vessels like the NAMUHO cannot be justified or tolerated, and we strongly condemn this." (위성락 국가안보실장이 11일 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호의 화재가 ‘외부공격’으로 드러난 데 대해 “우리 정부는 나무호 등 민간 선박에 대한 공격은 정당화되거나 용납될 수 없다는 입장으로서 이를 강력히 규탄한다”고 말했다.)

During a briefing at the Blue House, Advisor Wi said, "Through additional investigation, we intend to identify the perpetrator, the exact type of aircraft, and its physical dimensions," adding, "We will consider necessary responses and measures accordingly." (위 실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “우리는 추가 조사를 통해 공격 주체, 정확한 기종, 물리적 크기를 식별해 나가고자 한다”며 “거기에 따른 필요한 대응과 조치를 고려해 나갈 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Advisor Wi further stated, "We will continuously communicate with relevant countries to prevent recurrence and redouble efforts to enhance the safety of all our crew and vessels in the (nearby) strait," and "We will join international efforts to ensure the safety and free passage of all vessels, including ours." (위 실장은 이어 “사건이 재발하지 않도록 유관국과도 지속적으로 소통하고, (인근) 해협에 위치한 우리 모든 선원과 선박의 안전을 강화하기 위한 노력을 배가해 나갈 것”이라며 “우리를 포함한 모든 선박의 안전 보장, 자유로운 통항을 위한 국제사회 노력에 동참하겠다”고 말했다.)

The previous day, Ministry of Foreign Affairs Spokesperson Park Il announced, "Following a precise on-site investigation, CCTV review, and captain interview, it was determined that at 3:30 PM local time on the 4th, two unidentified aircraft struck the port side ballast tank plating of the HMM NAMUHO's stern twice, approximately one minute apart." (전날 박일 외교부 대변인은 “정밀한 현장조사, 시시티브이(CCTV) 확인 및 선장 면담 결과 4일 오후 3시30분(현지시각) 미상의 비행체 2기가 에이치엠엠 나무호 선미 좌현 평형수 탱크 외판을 약 1분 간격으로 두 차례 타격했다”고 밝혔다.)

The Blue House is cautious about naming a specific country as the perpetrator. A high-ranking Blue House official said, "We are not identifying the perpetrator at this time and are working to (uncover the cause)," adding, "It's difficult to say we will act based on preconceptions or premature conclusions. Once we have a determination, we will respond with an appropriate level of measures. The response will likely not differ significantly from what other countries would do in similar situations." (청와대는 공격 주체로 특정 국가가 거론되는 데 신중한 반응이다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “지금 공격 주체를 특정하지 않고, (원인을 밝히는 데) 노력하고 있다”며 “그때까지 예단을 갖거나 미리 단정해서 조치하겠다고 말하긴 어렵고, 판단이 서는 대로 거기에 맞는 적절한 수위에 따라 대처하겠다. 대처는 상식적으로 다른 나라들이 유사한 상황에 하는 대처와 크게 다르지 않을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Initially, our government had a high suspicion that the NAMUHO was attacked, but Advisor Wi Sung-lac adopted a cautious stance on the 6th, stating, "We cannot be certain it was an attack. There was no flooding or listing of the vessel." Regarding this, the high-ranking Blue House official explained, "Previously, we had not received reports of a breach, and it was difficult to make an overall judgment. It wasn't that we made a wrong judgment; we thought it appropriate to conduct a thorough investigation before making a decision." (애초 우리 정부는 나무호가 피격 가능성을 높게 판단했지만, 위성락 실장은 지난 6일 “피격을 확신할 수 없다. 일단 침수라든지 배가 기울어졌다거나 기울어짐은 없었다”며 신중한 태도를 보여왔다. 이를 두고 청와대 고위 관계자는 “지난번에는 파공이 있었다는 보고를 받지 못했고, 전체적으로 판단을 내리기가 어려웠다”며 “판단을 잘못 내린 것은 아니고, 정밀한 조사를 한 후에 판단하는 게 맞겠다고 생각한 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reported by Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government Cautious… Experts: “Iran Could Have Accidentally Attacked the HMM Naju” (정부는 신중…전문가들 “이란, 나무호 우발적 공격 가능성”)
item.description:
The government has confirmed that the HMM Naju, a South Korean vessel anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, was attacked twice by unidentified flying objects, but it has refrained from identifying the perpetrator, maintaining a cautious stance. (정부는 호르무즈해협에 정박중이던 한국 선박 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호가 외부 비행체의 두차례 공격을 받은 것으로 확인했지만, 공격 주체를 특정하지 않고 신중한 태도를 유지하고 있다.)

National Security Office Director Suh Hoon stated at a briefing at the Blue House on the 11th, “Our government’s position is that attacks on civilian vessels like the Naju cannot be justified or tolerated, and we strongly condemn this act.” However, a high-ranking official at the Blue House emphasized, “We are not currently identifying the perpetrator. We are in the process of making that determination.” This indicates that the government aims to secure clear evidence through a detailed investigation of the debris from the flying object’s engine recovered from the ship. The reason is that officially naming a specific country at this stage could cause significant diplomatic repercussions. (위성락 국가안보실장은 11일 청와대 브리핑에서 “우리 정부는 나무호 등 민간 선박에 대한 공격은 정당화하거나 용납될 수 없다는 입장으로 이를 강력히 규탄한다”고 말했다. 다만, 청와대 고위관계자는 “지금 공격의 주체를 특정하지 않고 있다. 특정을 위한 노력을 하고 있는 단계”라고 강조했다. 선박에서 수거된 비행체 엔진 잔해에 대한 정밀 조사를 통해 명확한 증거를 확보하겠다는 것이다. 지금 정부가 공식적으로 특정 국가를 지목할 경우 외교적 파장이 너무 크기 때문이다.)

Experts familiar with the situation in Iran are focusing on the possibility that Iran’s Revolutionary Guard might have carried out an accidental attack, based on the circumstances revealed so far. (이란 상황에 정통한 전문가들은 현재까지 공개된 정황을 근거로 이란 혁명수비대가 우발적 공격을 했을 가능성에 주목한다.)

Yoon Kang-hyun, a former ambassador to Iran, said, “It appears to be an attack by Iran’s Revolutionary Guard, but it does not seem to be a deliberate targeting of a Korean ship.” Former Ambassador Yoon explained, “Iran is trying to strengthen its control over the Strait of Hormuz by requiring ships to obtain its approval to use the ‘designated shipping lanes’ close to its territorial waters. At the time of the incident, our ships were gathered on the side of the United Arab Emirates, opposite to Iran’s ‘designated shipping lanes,’ and were attacked there. The Iranian military operates as a decentralized organization not fully controlled by the central government, so local commanders may have acted on their own judgment and targeted ships moving outside of their control.” He added, “South Korea has not withdrawn its embassy in Iran, has sent a special envoy, and the foreign ministers of both countries have been in communication. Iran has no reason to specifically target a South Korean ship.” He also noted that ships linked to Qatar, France, and China were also attacked around the same time as the Naju. (윤강현 전 주이란대사는 “이란 혁명수비대의 공격으로 보이지만 한국 배를 겨냥한 의도적 공격은 아닌 것으로 보인다”고 말했다. 윤 전 대사는 “이란은 선박들이 자국의 승인을 받아 이란쪽 영해에 가까운 ‘지정 항로’로 다니게 해 호르무즈해협 통제권을 강화하려 하고 있는데, 사건 당시 우리 선박들은 이란 ‘지정 항로’의 반대편인 아랍에미리트 쪽에 모여 있다가 공격을 받았다”며 “이란 군은 중앙정부가 통제하지 않는 분권형 조직으로 움직이고 있고 현장에서 각자 판단해 통제권 밖에서 움직이는 배들을 겨냥했을 것”이라고 분석했다. 이어 “한국은 주이란한국대사관도 철수시키지 않고 특사도 보냈고 양국 외교 장관끼리 소통도 계속해왔는데 이란이 한국 배를 특별히 겨냥할 이유가 없다”면서 나무호가 공격 받은 전후에 카타르, 프랑스, 중국 관련 선박들도 공격을 받은 점에도 주목했다.)

Professor Yoo Dal-seung of the Department of Persian and Iranian Studies at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies also said, “There is a possibility of an unexpected provocation by a local commander of Iran’s Revolutionary Guard.” The attack on the Naju occurred on the 4th, which was when the U.S. launched the ‘Freedom Project’ operation, initiating a reverse blockade of the Strait of Hormuz. Commanders feeling pressured by this may have carried out an unexpected attack. (유달승 한국외국어대 교수(페르시아·이란학과)도 “이란 혁명수비대의 현장 지휘관에 의한 돌발적인 도발이었을 가능성이 있다”고 말했다. 나무호가 공격을 받은 지난 4일은 미국이 ‘해방 프로젝트(프로젝트 프리덤)’ 작전을 시작하면서 호르무즈해협 역봉쇄에 나섰던 때이고, 이에 압박을 느낀 지휘관들이 돌발적으로 공격을 했다는 것이다.)

Nevertheless, experts argue that if the attack is confirmed to be by Iran, the government should demand an apology, compensation, and guarantees against recurrence from Iran, regardless of whether it was intentional or accidental. (그러면서 전문가들은 이란에 의한 공격으로 확인될 경우, 의도적이든 우발적이든 정부는 이란에 사과와 배상, 재발 방지 등을 요구해야 한다고 했다.)

Professor Yoo suggested, “Once clear evidence is secured through a detailed investigation, South Korea should demand a clear apology and corresponding measures from Iran. On the working level, there is a need for behind-the-scenes negotiations to ensure the safe passage of South Korean ships detained in the Strait of Hormuz.” Former Ambassador Yoon said, “We need to obtain an expression of regret and a promise to prevent recurrence from Iran. Rather than focusing on freeing just a few of our stranded ships, it should be a higher priority to manage relations with Iran to ensure the long-term safe navigation of our vessels.” (유 교수는 “정밀 조사를 통해 분명한 증거를 확보하면 이란에 명확한 사과와 상응하는 조치를 요구해야 하고, 실무선에서는 호르무즈해협에 억류된 한국 선박들의 안전한 통과에 대한 물밑 협상을 진행할 필요가 있다”고 제안했다. 윤 전 대사는 “이란으로부터 유감 표명과 재발 방지 약속 등은 받아야 한다”며 “발이 묶여 있는 우리 배 몇척을 나오게 하는 것보다는 우리 선박의 안전한 항해가 장기적으로 보장되도록 하는 이란과의 관계 관리를 더 우선해야 한다”고 말했다.)

U.S. President Donald Trump insisted immediately after the incident that the Naju was attacked by Iran and demanded that South Korea contribute to opening the Strait of Hormuz. If the Naju is confirmed to have been hit by Iran, U.S. pressure is likely to intensify. The U.S. has already proposed that South Korea join the ‘Maritime Freedom Coalition’ (MFC), a multinational alliance for keeping the Strait of Hormuz open. (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 사건 직후부터 나무호가 이란의 공격을 받았다면서 호르무즈해협 개방에 한국이 기여해야 한다고 요구했는데, 나무호가 실제로 이란으로부터 피격 당한 것으로 확인될 경우 미국의 요구도 강해질 가능성이 있다. 미국은 호르무즈해협 개방에 대한 다국적 연합체인 ‘해양자유연합’(MFC)에 한국의 참여를 제안한 상태다.)

Former Ambassador Yoon said, “After the war ends, if an initiative is formed involving all countries that use the Strait of Hormuz, we could participate. But joining a U.S.-led military operation just because the U.S. demands it now is not appropriate. The current situation is that even U.S. warships are afraid to enter the strait.” (윤 전 대사는 “전쟁이 끝난 뒤에 호르무즈해협을 이용하는 모든 국가가 참여하는 이니셔티브가 구성되면 우리가 참여할 수 있지만, 지금 미국이 요구한다고 미국이 주도하는 군사 작전에 참여하는 것은 적절하지 않다”며 “현재는 미국 군함도 두려워서 해협에 진입하지 못하는 상황”이라고 말했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "The Democratic Party's Preferential Voting System for National Assembly Speaker Saves Costs and Time" (이 대통령 “민주당 국회의장 후보 선호투표제, 비용·시간 아끼는 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated regarding the preferential voting system implemented in the Democratic Party of Korea's primary for the National Assembly speaker candidate, "It is meant to save the costs and time required for a runoff election," adding, "If South Korea introduces a runoff system for elections such as the presidential election, we will discuss simultaneously adopting a preferential voting system." (이재명 대통령이 더불어민주당 국회의장 후보 경선에서 시행되는 선호투표제에 대해 “결선투표를 위한 비용과 시간을 아끼기 위한 것”이라며 “우리나라도 대선 등의 선거에서 결선투표제를 도입할 경우 선호투표제 동시도입을 논의하게 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

In a post on X on the 11th, President Lee said, "The preferential voting system was introduced alongside the runoff system when I was the leader of the Democratic Party." The Democratic Party has been conducting a two-day vote among eligible party members starting that day to select the candidate for the speaker of the second half of the National Assembly. In response to a post from an X user who had completed voting, asking, "If only one person is to be elected, why rank them?" Lee explained the purpose of the preferential voting system in a reply format. The candidates in this primary are lawmakers Park Ji-won, Cho Jung-sik, and Kim Tae-nyeon (in the order of their assigned symbols). (이 대통령은 11일 엑스(X)에 올린 글에서 “선호투표제는 제가 민주당 대표일 때 결선투표제와 함께 도입한 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 민주당은 이날부터 이틀간 국회 후반기 의장 후보를 뽑는 권리당원 투표를 실시 중인데, 투표를 완료했다는 한 엑스 이용자가 “뽑을 사람은 한명인데 왜 순위를 매기느냐”는 글을 올리자 답글 형식으로 선호투표제 취지를 설명했다. 이번 경선에는 박지원·조정식·김태년(기호순) 의원이 출마했다. )

The preferential voting system is implemented when there are three or more candidates in the Democratic Party's process for selecting the National Assembly speaker candidate and floor leader. If no candidate receives a majority in the first round of voting, the core idea is to add the second-preference votes of voters who chose the third-place candidate as their first preference to the vote counts of the first- and second-place candidates to determine a majority winner. Accordingly, participants in the vote must indicate their preference rankings for all candidates. The X user stated that they voted for Cho Jung-sik as their first choice among the National Assembly speaker primary candidates. (선호투표제는 민주당 국회의장 후보 및 원내대표 선출 과정에서 경선 후보자가 3인 이상일 때 실시한다. 1차 투표에서 과반 득표자가 나오지 않으면, 3위 후보자를 1순위로 택한 유권자의 2순위 표를 1, 2위 후보자의 득표수에 더해 과반 득표자를 가리는 것이 골자다. 이에 따라 투표 참여자들은 모든 후보자에 대한 선호 순위를 표기해야 한다. 이 엑스 이용자는 국회의장 경선 후보 가운데 조정식 의원에게 1위 투표를 했다고 밝혔다)

President Lee explained, "This is a method of effectively conducting a runoff vote in advance within the first round of voting," adding, "It has the limitation that voters who selected the first- and second-place candidates in the first round are considered to have made the same choices in the runoff." He continued, "Please be aware that if you do not select a second choice, you would effectively be abstaining from the runoff vote if your first-choice candidate is eliminated. Please avoid misunderstanding and be sure to select both your first and second preferences." (이 대통령은 “1차 투표에서 예비적으로 결선투표를 미리 해 두는 방안”이라며 “1차 투표에서 1, 2위를 선택한 선거권자는 결선투표에서도 동일한 선택을 하는 것으로 간주하는 한계가 있다”고 설명했다. 이어 “2등을 선택해 두지 않으면 본인이 1등으로 선택한 후보가 탈락한 결선투표에는 기권하는 결과가 되는 점을 숙지하시고, 오해하지 마시고 1, 2등 선호를 모두 선택하시기 바란다”고 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon told reporters that day, "We will announce the central election committee before candidate registration this Thursday or Friday," adding, "Since the party leader has previously served as the chairperson of the standing election committee, this time will be no different." <<> Amid this, Joo Gwang-deok, a preliminary candidate for the Namyangju mayoral election under the People Power Party, stated that if Leader Jang does not step back to the second line, he will not register as a candidate. item.title: DP on Edge Over Jeonbuk Poll?… Relentless 'Check' on Independent Kim Gwan-young (민주, 전북 여론조사에 긴장?…무소속 김관영에 연일 ‘견제구’)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea (DP) is steadily raising the pressure on incumbent Governor Kim Gwan-young, who has declared his independent candidacy for the Jeonbuk Special Self-Governing Province gubernatorial election on June 3. Kim, expelled from the party over allegations of distributing cash for designated driver fees, is showing competitiveness against DP candidate Lee Won-taek in opinion polls, fueling a tense atmosphere. (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거 전북특별자치도지사 선거에 무소속 출마를 선언한 김관영 현 지사에 대한 견제 수위를 연일 끌어올리고 있다. 대리운전비 현금 살포 의혹으로 당에서 제명된 김 후보가 이원택 민주당 후보를 상대로 여론조사에서 경쟁력을 보이면서 긴장하는 분위기다.)

DP Chief Jeong Cheong-rae said on the 11th at a Seoul-area candidate convention held at the Korea Federation of Small and Medium Businesses in Yeouido, “Do you have the confidence to win as an independent? Please remember you are in the arms of the DP members.” Although this remark was made at a gathering of Seoul-area candidates for the June 3 local elections, including Seoul mayoral candidate Jeong Won-oh, it was interpreted as targeting Kim. <<>= Floor Leader Han Byeong-do, whose constituency is Iksan-eul in Jeonbuk, added an extra schedule on the same day to hold a press briefing at the Jeonbuk Provincial Council, stating, “Jeonbuk’s development can only happen if a candidate from the ruling DP wins.” The previous day, Secretary-General Jo Seung-rae warned Kim that running as an independent constitutes a 'grave breach of party discipline' and that he would forever be barred from rejoining the party. (정청래 민주당 대표는 11일 서울 여의도 중소기업중앙회에서 열린 서울지역 공천자 대회에서 “무소속으로 당선될 자신이 있나. 여러분은 민주당 당원들 품 속에 있다는 사실을 명심해달라”고 말했다. 정원오 서울시장 후보 등 6·3 지방선거 서울지역 후보자들이 참석한 자리에서 한 발언이었지만, 김 후보를 겨냥한 발언이란 해석이 나왔다.)

The DP's sustained offensive is likely due to assessments that Kim retains considerable local support despite his independent run. In a survey of 1,000 Jeonbuk residents conducted by Research firm Jo Won C&I on the 9th and 10th, commissioned by News1 (using mobile phone virtual numbers in an automated response method), Kim garnered 43.2% support, while Lee received 39.7%. (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) Kim’s camp believes that public sentiment in the region views as unfair the central party's actions, such as the investigation into Kim's alleged cash disbursement for designated driver fees and the probe into Lee's alleged third-party payment of meal costs. (전북 익산을이 지역구인 한병도 원내대표는 이날 일정을 추가해 전북도의회에서 기자간담회를 열고 “전북 발전은 집권 여당인 민주당 후보가 당선돼야 가능한 일”이라고 말했다. 전날 조승래 사무총장은 김 후보를 향해 무소속 출마는 ‘중대한 해당 행위’라며 영원히 복당이 불가능할 것이란 경고를 내놓기도 했다.)

Choi Ha-yan Reporter chy@hani.co.kr Cheon Gyeong-seok Reporter 1000press@hani.co.kr (연일 이어지는 민주당의 공세는 김 후보가 무소속 출마를 선언했음에도 지역 지지세가 만만치 않다는 평가가 나오기 때문인 것으로 보인다. 여론조사 전문기관 조원씨앤아이가 9~10일 뉴스1 의뢰로 전북 거주 1천명을 대상으로 한 전북지사 적합도 조사(휴대전화 가상번호 활용 자동응답 방식)에서 김 후보는 43.2%, 이 후보는 39.7%를 기록했다.(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조) 김 후보 쪽은 대리운전비 현금 살포 의혹과 이 후보의 식사비 제3자 대납 의혹에 대한 중앙당의 감찰 등 조처가 불공정했다는 여론이 지역 내에서 형성되고 있다고 보고 있다.)
