item.title: DP’s ‘Balanced Development’ vs. PPP’s ‘Housing Stability’ as Top Pledges… A Look at Each Party’s Top 10 Campaign Promises (민주 ‘균형발전’-국힘 ‘주거안정’ 1호 공약…정당별 10대 공약 보니)
item.description:
On May 11, 23 days before the June 3 local elections, rival parties unveiled their top 10 campaign pledges. The Democratic Party (DP), which is focusing on winning over voters in the Yeongnam region, highlighted ‘regional balanced development,’ while the People Power Party (PPP), aiming to tap into public sentiment on real estate, promoted ‘housing stability’ as its key pledge. (6·3 지방선거를 23일 앞둔 11일 여야 정당들이 지방선거 10대 공약을 발표했다. 영남권 표심 확보에 공을 들이고 있는 더불어민주당은 ‘지역균형발전’을, 부동산 민심을 파고들려는 국민의힘은 ‘주거 안정’을 주요 공약으로 내세웠다.)

According to the policies and pledges of 15 political parties published on the website of the National Election Commission on the same day, the DP designated ‘building an administrative, fiscal, and institutional foundation for balanced development’ as its top priority. The plan is to complete the ‘5 Poles, 3 Specialties’ (five mega-regions and three special self-governing provinces) strategy for national balanced development under the Lee Jae-myung administration, partly through the integration of metropolitan governments beyond South Jeolla and Gwangju. The DP also unveiled plans to foster key regional industries by designating ‘mega special zones’ with eased regulations and support in finance, taxation, and workforce, as well as to nurture new AI (artificial intelligence) industries and build a growth foundation. (중앙선거관리위원회가 이날 누리집에 공개한 15개 정당의 정책·공약을 보면, 민주당은 ‘균형발전을 위한 행정·재정·제도 기반 구축’을 첫번째 과제로 꼽았다. 전남·광주 이외에 광역 지방정부의 통합 등을 통해 이재명 정부의 국가 균형발전 전략인 ‘5극 3특’(5개 초광역권과 3개 특별자치도)을 완성하겠다는 구상이다. 민주당은 규제를 완화하고, 재정·세제·인력을 지원하는 ‘메가특구’를 지정해 지역 핵심 산업을 육성하고, 에이아이(AI·인공지능) 신산업 육성 및 성장기반을 구축하겠다는 계획도 내놨다.)

Additionally, the DP presented key pledges including: △ close support for youth, national asset formation, and reduction of household living expenses; △ national livelihood stability, care support, and response to low birth rates and an aging population; △ response to the RE100 climate crisis; △ support for startups, small business owners, and SMEs; and △ strengthening public safety, including for women. (이밖에 민주당은 △청년밀착 지원 국민 자산 형성 및 가계생활비 경감 지원 △국민 생활안정, 돌봄 지원, 저출생고령화 대응 △알이(RE)100 기후위기 대응 △창업·소상공인·중소기업 지원 △여성 등 국민안전 강화 등도 핵심 공약으로 제시했다.)

The PPP put forward ‘housing stability,’ centered on introducing ‘half-price jeonse’ (long-term rental deposits), as its top pledge. Key promises include promoting ‘half-price jeonse’ by supplying long-term rental housing at 50% of surrounding prices, expanding the tax credit for monthly rent, abolishing the recapture of excess profits from reconstruction, and reinstating benefits for long-term rental business operators. This is interpreted as a strategy to differentiate itself from the government and ruling party’s real estate policies while aggressively targeting public sentiment on property. The second pledge was ‘a great economic leap through regulatory abolition and new industry growth,’ which includes introducing a Korean version of the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) tax incentive for domestic production and fully implementing a negative regulatory system. For youth pledges, the party proposed 1,000-won housing, 1,000-won breakfast, improved monthly rent support for young people, and mandatory quotas for public rental housing for youth and newlyweds. (국민의힘은 ‘반값 전세’ 도입을 골자로 한 ‘주거 안정’을 1호 공약으로 내세웠다. 주변 가격의 50%로 장기전세주택을 공급하는 ‘반값 전세’ 추진, 월세 세액공제 확대, 재건축 초과이익 환수제 폐지, 장기임대사업자 혜택 부활 등이 핵심 공약이다. 정부·여당의 부동산 정책과 차별화하며 부동산 민심을 집중적으로 파고들겠다는 전략으로 풀이된다. 한국판 국내생산촉진세제(IRA) 도입, 네거티브 방식의 규제 시스템 전면 도입 등의 내용이 담긴 ‘규제 철폐와 신산업 성장을 통한 경제 대도약’은 두번째 공약으로 제시했다. 청년 공약으로는 천원주택, 천원의 아침밥, 청년 월세 지원 향상, 청년·신혼부부 공공임대 쿼터제 의무화 등을 내세웠다.)

The Rebuilding Korea Party (RKP) put forward a ’99-year lifetime secure home’ as its top pledge. It promises to guarantee housing rights by supplying high-quality public rental apartment complexes nationwide that are permanently owned by the public without conversion to sale. The Progressive Party prioritized the ’nationalization of local public services, building local public assets, and realizing a local circular economy’ through measures such as bus nationalization and establishing regional public banks. The Reform Party promoted a ’growth economy that reduces regulations and fosters innovation.’ Key measures include a ’zero-burden package for youth startups’ for entrepreneurs aged 39 and under, encompassing temporary support for workplace rent, reduced corporate establishment costs, and tax and legal advisory services. (조국혁신당은 ‘99년 평생 안심 내 집’을 1호 공약으로 내세웠다. 분양전환 없이 공공이 영구 보유하는 고품질의 공공임대 아파트 단지를 전국에 공급해 주거권을 보장한다는 공약이다. 진보당은 버스 공영화, 지역공공은행 설립 등을 통한 ‘지역공공서비스 공영화와 지역공공자산 구축, 지역순환경제 실현’을 첫번째 공약으로 내세웠다. 개혁신당은 ‘규제는 줄이고, 혁신은 키우는 성장경제’를 내세웠다. 만 39살 이하 청년 창업자 대상 사업장 임대료 한시 지원, 법인 설립 비용 감면, 세무·법률 자문 등을 포함한 ‘청년 창업 제로 부담 패키지’ 추진 등이 주요 내용이다.)

The Basic Income Party advocated for ’realizing local government-level basic income’ by implementing basic income (300,000 won per month) for rural areas and children, adolescents, and youth. The Social Democratic Party put forward ’responding to AI inequality and job insecurity’ as its top pledge, while the Justice Party called for ‘building a system where the public takes responsibility for basic services such as housing, food, transportation, and medical care’ as its number one pledge. (기본소득당은 농어촌 및 아동·청소년·청년 기본소득(월 30만원)을 시행하는 ‘지방정부형 기본소득 실현’을, 사회민주당은 ‘에이아이 불평등 및 고용 불안 대응’을, 정의당은 ‘주거, 먹거리, 교통, 의료 등 기본서비스를 공공이 책임지는 체제 구축’을 제1공약으로 내세웠다.)

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kang Hoon-sik on High School Student's Murder: "Extraordinary Measures Needed... We Must Painfully Listen to Youths' Questions" (강훈식, 고교생 피살에 “특단 대책…청소년들 물음 아프게 들어야”)
item.description:
Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, regarding the murder of a high school student in Gwangju, stated, "This incident must not be taken lightly," and instructed the government to prepare extraordinary measures. <<> Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryung of the presidential office reported that Chief Kang made these remarks during a meeting of senior presidential secretaries he chaired, noting that students in the affected area have been issuing statements calling for strict punishment of the perpetrator. Since the incident on the 5th, where a 17-year-old female high school student returning home in Gwangju was fatally stabbed by a 20-something male stranger, high school students in Gwangju and Gangwon Province have been issuing successive statements urging social attention to the case, strong punishment for the perpetrator, and measures to prevent recurrence. <<> In a Facebook post on the same day, Chief Kang said, "A youth was harmed by an adult's violence. The victims are asking whether safety issues for youths and other vulnerable groups in our society are being neglected. We must listen painstakingly." <<> During the meeting, he expressed condolences and solidarity to the bereaved family and local students, and instructed Senior Secretary for Communication Jeon Seong-hwan to "meet directly with the bereaved family and the family of the injured student, convey the government's condolences, and carefully ensure that necessary support and measures are promptly implemented." Secretary Jeon immediately moved to the scene. Chief Kang also requested the National Police Agency to "conduct thorough investigations, strengthen patrols during crime-vulnerable times and locations, and carry out day-and-night safety inspections of student commuting routes and reinforce security facilities to implement extraordinary safety measures so that youths are not exposed to random crimes." <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (강훈식 대통령비서실장이 광주 고교생 피살 사건과 관련해 “이번 사건을 결코 가볍게 여겨서는 안 된다”라며 정부에 특단의 대책을 마련하라고 지시했다.)

item.title: National Security Office Chief: "Strongly Condemns Attack on M.V. HMM MUH"… Debris Identified as Drone Remains (위성락 “나무호 공격 강력히 규탄”…잔해는 드론으로 확인)
item.description:
National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac stated on the 11th regarding the attack on the HMM MUH while it was anchored in the Strait of Hormuz: "Our government's position is that attacks on civilian vessels such as the HMM MUH cannot be justified or tolerated, and we strongly condemn this act." The government has secured drone engine debris from the hull of the HMM MUH and has initiated further investigations. (위성락 국가안보실장이 11일 호르무즈해협에서 정박 중이던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호 피격에 대해 “우리 정부는 나무호 등 민간 선박에 대한 공격은 정당화되거나 용납될 수 없다는 입장으로, 이를 강력히 규탄한다”고 말했다. 정부는 나무호 선체에서 드론 엔진 잔해를 확보하고 추가 조사에 들어갔다.)

During a briefing at the presidential office (Cheong Wa Dae) that day, Director Wi said: "Military attacks on ordinary commercial vessels are clearly unacceptable and subject to criticism. We will take appropriate measures at the appropriate level once our assessment is complete." (위 실장은 이날 청와대에서 한 브리핑에서 “일반 상선에 대한 군사적 공격은 용납될 수 없고 비판의 대상임이 분명하다”며 “판단이 서는 대로 적절한 수위의 대처를 할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding the attack situation, Director Wi stated: "Two unidentified aircraft struck the stern plating of the HMM MUH twice, approximately one minute apart, resulting in flames and smoke accompanied by vibrations. Considering that the ship was damaged at a point 1 to 1.5 meters above the waterline at the time of the incident, as well as the damage patterns, the possibility of an attack by mines or torpedoes appears low." (위 실장은 피격 상황에 관해 “미상의 비행체 2기가 나무호 선미 외판을 약 1분 간격으로 두차례 타격했고, 진동을 동반한 화염과 연기가 발생했다”며 “사고 당시 해수면보다 1~1.5m 상단 부분에 선박 파손이 있었다는 점이나 파손 패턴 등을 고려하면 기뢰나 어뢰에 의한 피격 가능성은 작은 것으로 보인다”고 말했다.)

However, Cheong Wa Dae did not identify the entity responsible for the attack. A senior official from Cheong Wa Dae stated: "We are not currently identifying the attacker; we are working to determine the cause. Until then, it is difficult to say that we will take measures based on prejudice or premature conclusions about the attacker." Regarding future responses, this official added: "Our response will likely not differ significantly from how other countries handle similar situations." Notably, France and China, which experienced attacks on their vessels around the same time as the HMM MUH, have also mentioned the attacks without specifying the attackers. (다만 청와대는 공격 주체가 어디인지는 언급하지 않았다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “지금 공격 주체를 특정하지 않고, (원인을 밝히는 데) 노력하고 있다”며 “그때까지 (공격 주체에) 예단을 갖거나 미리 단정해 조치하겠다고 말하긴 어렵다”고 했다. 이 관계자는 향후 대응에 관해 “대처는 상식적으로 다른 나라들이 이런 유사한 상황에 대처하는 것과 크게 다르지 않을 것”이라고 말했다. 앞서 나무호와 비슷한 시기에 선박 공격을 받은 프랑스와 중국 역시 피격 사실은 언급하면서도 공격 주체를 명시하지 않았다.)

Amidst this, the government has confirmed the recovery of drone engine debris from the hull of the HMM MUH. Multiple sources from the ruling party told *The Hankyoreh*: "Drone debris has been secured from the HMM MUH's hull and will be brought to South Korea soon for analysis." The Ministry of Foreign Affairs had previously stated the previous day, "Further investigation is needed to determine whether the projectile was a drone or a missile," without clarifying further. A senior Cheong Wa Dae official, when asked about the debris of the aircraft that day, only stated: "We will speak when additional information is gathered and an assessment is made." (이런 가운데 정부는 나무호 선체에서 드론 엔진 잔해를 확보한 것으로 확인됐다. 복수의 여권 소식통은 한겨레에 “나무호 선체에서 드론 잔해를 확보했고, 곧 한국으로 가져와 감식할 예정”이라고 말했다. 외교부는 전날 “발사체가 드론인지 미사일인지 추가 조사가 필요하다”며 명확히 밝히지 않았다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 이날 비행체 잔해와 관련한 질문에 “추가적인 정보가 파악되고 판단이 서게 되면 말하겠다”고만 말했다.)

Seo Young-ji and Shim Woo-sam, reporters, yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 심우삼 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Claims “Iran Admits to Attacking the HMM Nammoo” … Democratic Party Says “Unfounded Attacks Harm National Interest” (국힘 “나무호 피격, 이란 자백”…민주 “근거 없는 공격, 국익 해쳐”)
item.description:
Amid findings that the explosion and fire on the HMM Nammoo, which was anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, were caused by a strike from an unidentified flying object, the conservative opposition party has pushed back, demanding that the government reveal the perpetrator. The Democratic Party of Korea characterized this as a “political offensive aimed at the elections,” retorting that “they are stoking partisan strife even before the exact investigation results are out.” <<> Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, said at a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the 11th: “The first results of the government investigation team are missing two essential characters: ‘Iran.’ Iran’s state broadcaster has already reported that they targeted a Korean vessel. The attacker is confessing, but the victim is denying it.” Regarding the government’s statement that the attacker was an unidentified flying object, he asked, “Did an alien UFO attack occur?” and claimed, “The money that the Lee Jae-myung regime gave to Iran may have returned as a drone that attacked our ship.” Floor leader Choo Kyung-ho stated, “It looks like a sluggish, downplaying response for a serious security issue involving the lives and safety of the people. The government must transparently disclose to the public the details and response process of the HMM Nammoo attack.” <<> Lawmakers from the People Power Party on the National Defense Committee and Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee held a joint press conference at the National Assembly on the same day, accusing the government of covering up facts related to the attack and urging the convening of a full committee meeting for urgent inquiries. The National Defense Committee held a full meeting in the afternoon led by the People Power Party, but the government and ruling party did not attend due to a breakdown in negotiations between the ruling and opposition party secretaries. The Reform Party sent a letter to the Iranian Ambassador to South Korea, Saeed Koozechi, on the same day, stating, “Protecting our citizens and our ships is not a matter of choice. If attacks on Korean ships continue, the Reform Party will urge the Korean government to take stronger diplomatic and legal action.” <<> In contrast, the Democratic Party of Korea has adopted a cautious approach, aligning with the government. Deputy spokesperson Boo Seung-chan of the Democratic Party’s Central Election Strategy Committee issued a commentary, noting, “The facts—who the attacker is, whether it was an intentional strike or an accident—have a massive impact on diplomatic responses afterward. The People Power Party completely ignores this complex reality and the basics of diplomacy. They repeat irresponsible and ruinous behavior, using security as a tool for partisan strife solely to attack the Lee Jae-myung administration.” Rep. Kim Young-bae, the Democratic Party’s secretary on the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee, also addressed the People Power Party’s demand for a committee meeting, emphasizing, “The Democratic Party believes it’s better to hold a committee meeting once the type of aircraft and the attacker are identified,” and stressed they were not avoiding it. <<> A Democratic Party lawmaker on the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee told The Hankyoreh on the same day, “I don’t know what they want to do when the type of aircraft and the attacker haven’t even been identified. Isn’t this just using the issue for election purposes and potentially threatening the safety of our overseas nationals?” Another Democratic Party lawmaker said, “Unfounded malicious propaganda or attacks are also inappropriate from a national interest perspective.” <<> Jang Narae Reporter wing@hani.co.kr Ko Kyungju Reporter goh@hani.co.kr
Yoo Youngjae Reporter young@hani.co.kr (호르무즈해협에 정박해 있던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호의 폭발·화재 원인이 외부 비행체의 타격으로 지목된 가운데 보수 야당이 정부에 공격 주체를 밝히라고 요구하며 반발했다. 더불어민주당은 ‘선거를 겨냥한 정치 공세’로 규정하고 “정확한 조사 결과가 나오기도 전에 정쟁의 군불부터 때고 있다”고 맞받았다.)

item.title: Korea Football Association Submits Application to Allow North Korean 'Naegohyang Women's Football Team' to Visit the South (축구협회 ‘북한 내고향여자축구단’ 방남 허가신청서 제출)
item.description:
The Korea Football Association has submitted an application for permission to allow the North Korean women's football team 'Naegohyang Women's Football Team' to visit South Korea. (대한축구협회가 북한 여자 축구단 ‘내고향여자축구단’의 남한 방문을 위한 방남 허가 신청서를 제출했다.)

The Ministry of Unification announced on the 11th that the Korea Football Association submitted the application for Naegohyang Women's Football Team (Naegohyang) to visit the South online to the ministry the previous day (the 10th). Under the law on inter-Korean exchange and cooperation, any North Korean resident wishing to visit South Korea must possess a visitor certificate issued by the Minister of Unification. The Korea Football Association applied for the visit permit after receiving the list of the North Korean athletes and support staff scheduled to visit through the Asian Football Confederation (AFC). (통일부는 축구협회가 전날(10일) 통일부에 내고향여자축구단(내고향)의 방남 허가 신청을 온라인으로 제출했다고 11일 밝혔다. 남북교류협력에 관한 법률상 북한의 주민이 남한을 방문하려면 통일부 장관이 발급한 방문증명서를 소지해야 한다. 축구협회는 아시아축구연맹(AFC)을 통해 방남 예정인 북한 선수단과 지원 인력의 명단을 받아 방남 허가를 신청했다.)

According to the list received by the Asian Football Confederation from North Korea, the visiting group consists of 39 people, including 27 Naegohyang players and 12 staff members. They are scheduled to enter South Korea via Incheon Airport through Beijing, China, on the 17th. The Ministry of Unification plans to approve the visit by the 17th, the scheduled arrival date of Naegohyang, following consultations with relevant agencies. A ministry official stated, "The list of 39 people includes four reserve players, so it is not yet certain whether all of them will visit," indicating that the number of visitors might be fewer than 39. (아시아축구연맹이 북한으로부터 받은 명단상 방남 인원은 내고향 선수 27명, 스태프 12명 등 39명으로, 오는 17일 중국 베이징을 거쳐 인천공항을 통해 남한에 들어온다. 통일부는 관계기관 협의를 거쳐 내고향의 도착 예정일인 17일 전까지 방문 승인을 할 계획이다. 통일부 관계자는 “39명 명단에 예비 선수 인력도 4명 포함돼 있어 이들이 모두 방문할지는 아직 불확실하다”고 해, 39명보다 적은 인원이 방문할 가능성도 있다고 밝혔다.)

The Korea Football Association's application for the visit was made independently based on the list received from the Asian Football Confederation, in accordance with South Korean procedures, without separate communication with the North Korean side. As a result, there are observations that North Korea might refuse entry following the visit application and demand immigration procedures through passport verification. Amid the situation where North Korea defines inter-Korean relations as a 'two-state' relationship, it could express its intention to undergo identity and entry requirement checks through passport screening, similar to general state-to-state relations. Immigration screening also requires consultation with the Ministry of Justice. Indeed, the Ministry of Unification is reportedly reviewing relevant response measures considering this point. (축구협회의 방남 신청은 북한 쪽과 따로 소통을 거치진 않고, 우리 절차에 따라 아시아축구연맹에서 받은 명단을 토대로 자체 신청한 것이다. 이에 북한 쪽에서 방남 신청에 따른 입국을 거부하고 여권 확인을 통한 출입국 절차를 요구할 가능성도 있다는 관측이 나온다. 북한이 남북을 ‘두 국가’ 관계로 규정하는 상황에서 일반적인 국가 대 국가 관계와 같이 여권 심사를 거쳐 신원 등 입국 요건을 확인받겠다는 뜻을 밝힐 수 있다는 것이다. 출입국 심사는 법무부와도 협의가 필요하다. 실제로 통일부는 이런 점을 고려해 관련 대응 방안을 검토 중인 것으로 전해졌다.)

After arriving in Incheon on the 17th, Naegohyang will play a semifinal match of the Asian Football Confederation Women's Champions League against Suwon FC Women at Suwon Sports Complex on the 20th. The winner will compete for the championship against the winner of the semifinal match between Melbourne City and Tokyo Verdy at 2 p.m. on the 23rd at the same venue. (내고향은 17일 인천에 도착한 뒤, 20일 수원FC 위민과 수원종합운동장에서 아시아축구연맹 여자 챔피언스리그 4강전을 한다. 승자는 멜버른 시티-도쿄 베르디의 4강전 승자와 오는 23일 오후 2시 같은 곳에서 우승을 다툰다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘Attacked’ – France and China Also Do Not Specify… Blue House Cautious Over Diplomatic Fallout (‘피격’ 프랑스·중국도 명시 안 해…청와대, 외교 파장 ‘신중’)
item.description:
The Blue House on the 11th “strongly condemned” the attack on the HMM *Namuho*, but did not specify the perpetrator. This is because hastily pointing fingers at Iran could jeopardize the safety of about 20 South Korean vessels stranded in the Strait of Hormuz and potentially lead to pressure from the U.S. to join its anti-Iran coalition. The government is expected to maintain a cautious stance until further investigation results emerge. (청와대가 11일 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호 피격 사건에 대해 “강력히 규탄한다”면서도 공격 주체를 명시하지 않았다. 이란을 섣불리 지목할 경우 호르무즈해협에 묶인 20여척의 한국 선박에 대한 안전을 확보하기 어려운데다, 미국의 대이란 공조 압박으로 이어질 수 있기 때문이다. 정부는 추가 조사 결과가 나올 때까지 최대한 신중한 태도를 유지할 것으로 보인다.)

A senior Blue House official told reporters on the same day, “Whether the external attack on the *Namuho* is related to Iran is currently an unknown territory.” He added, “No specific country has been identified. We are looking into possibilities involving multiple countries.” While sources inside and outside the government suggest a high likelihood of Iranian involvement, this has not been acknowledged. Regarding the Foreign Ministry summoning Iranian Ambassador to South Korea Saeed Kouzehchi the previous day, the official explained, “It wasn’t about singling out a specific target, but rather about communication and consultation with one of the neighboring countries,” denying that it was a formal protest. (청와대 고위 관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “(나무호의 외부 공격이) 이란과 관련이 있는지는 지금 현재는 미지의 영역”이라며 “어느 나라가 특정돼 있지는 않다. 여러 나라의 가능성을 놓고 파악하고 있다”고 말했다. 정부 안팎에서는 이란의 공격 가능성이 높다고 보고 있지만, 이를 인정하지는 않은 것이다. 이 관계자는 전날 외교부가 사이드 쿠제치 주한 이란대사를 부른 것에 관해서도 “대상을 특정한 것이 아니라 인근 나라 가운데 하나이기 때문에 소통, 협의하는 차원이었다”며 ‘초치’라는 해석을 부인했다.)

The government’s cautious stance stems from the significant diplomatic repercussions that could follow a definitive judgment. If Iran’s attack is confirmed, the deterioration of relations with Iran, cultivated with effort so far, would be unavoidable. Currently, besides the *Namuho*, 25 South Korean vessels remain in the Strait of Hormuz. Strained ties with Iran could disrupt the passage of South Korean ships through the strait and the securing of crude oil. (정부가 신중한 태도를 유지하는 것은 판단 이후의 외교적 파장이 만만찮기 때문이다. 이란의 공격이 사실로 확인될 경우 그동안 공들여온 이란과의 관계 악화가 일정 부분 불가피하다. 현재 호르무즈해협에는 나무호 외에도 우리 선박 25척이 남아 있다. 이란과의 관계가 악화하면 전후 한국 선박의 호르무즈해협 통과와 원유 확보에도 차질이 생길 수 있다.)

Pressure from the U.S. for military cooperation is also seen as a factor behind the caution. If South Korea concludes that Iran carried out the attack, the U.S. is likely to ramp up pressure for participation in the ‘Liberation Project’ (Project Freedom), which has been on hold. A senior Blue House official stated, “I don’t think it’s to the point of directly linking (participation in the U.S.-proposed Maritime Freedom Coalition (MFC) and this attack).” He added, “It is true that we were attacked and that’s something to condemn, but the perpetrator hasn’t been identified yet,” reiterating a basic stance. (미국의 군사적 협력 압박도 신중론의 배경으로 풀이된다. 한국이 이란의 공격을 받았다고 결론을 내릴 경우 미국은 중단 상태인 ‘해방 프로젝트’(프로젝트 프리덤) 참여를 다시 압박할 가능성이 적지 않다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “(미국이 제안한 해양자유연합(MFC) 참여와 이번 공격을) 직접 연결시킬 정도는 아니라고 생각한다”며 “지금 우리가 피습당한 건 규탄할 일인 건 맞는데, 누가 했는지는 주체가 아직 특정되지 않은 단계다”라며 원론적 입장을 밝혔다.)

The government is expected to align its response level with countries like France, China, and Thailand, whose vessels were also attacked around the same time. France and China have confirmed the attacks but have not named a specific country like Iran as the perpetrator; Thailand lodged a protest with Iran through its foreign ministry. The senior Blue House official said, “We are closely watching how other countries are handling this. Our current response is not significantly different from how other countries are dealing with similar situations realistically.” (정부는 우리와 비슷한 시기 자국 선박이 공격받은 프랑스와 중국, 타이 등과 대응 수위를 맞출 것으로 보인다. 프랑스와 중국은 피격 사실은 확인했지만 ‘이란’ 등 특정 국가를 공격 주체로 명시하지 않았고, 타이는 외무부를 통해 이란에 항의했다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “다른 나라들의 대처를 면밀히 보고 있다. 우리가 하고 있는 대처는 현실적으로 다른 나라들이 유사한 상황에 대처하는 것에서 크게 다르지 않다”고 말했다.)

Some interpret the “strong condemnation” message as an attempt to appease the domestic conservative base. With local elections on June 3 about 20 days away, the People Power Party and others are heavily criticizing the Lee Jae-myung government for being lukewarm toward Iran while failing to protect the people’s safety. In this context, the government may have issued the ‘condemnation’ message to show a firm stance. (일부에서는 “강력 규탄” 언급은 국내 보수층을 달래려는 메시지라는 풀이도 있다. 국민의힘 등은 6·3 지방선거를 20여일 앞두고 이재명 정부가 국민의 안전을 지키지 못한 채 이란에 미온적인 태도를 보이고 있다며 맹공을 펴고 있다. 이런 상황에서 정부가 ‘규탄’ 메시지를 내어 단호한 태도를 보이려 했다는 것이다.)

Meanwhile, regarding National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac’s comment on the 6th that “we cannot be certain of the *Namuho* attack” and that “no report of a breach was received,” the Blue House stated, “It was not a misjudgment.” (한편, 청와대는 지난 6일 “나무호의 피격을 확신할 수 없다”고 한 위성락 국가안보실장의 언급에 대해서는 “파공이 있었다는 보고를 받지 못했다”며 “판단을 잘못 내린 것은 아니다”라고 말했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Everyone shouts 'youth pledges,' but youth politics faces high barriers (너도나도 ‘청년 공약’ 외치지만…청년 정치 높은 벽)
item.description:
Ahead of the June 3 local elections, political parties and candidates are competing to put forward youth pledges, but in these elections as well, only a small number of those in their 20s and 30s, the actual stakeholders, are stepping forward as political actors to voice their opinions. The reasons cited include the fact that the barriers to entry remain high for young people, and political parties also take a passive stance toward nurturing young politicians. (6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 정당과 후보들이 앞다투어 청년 공약을 내놓고 있지만, 이번 선거에도 당사자인 20~30대들이 직접 정치적 주체로 나서 목소리를 내는 경우는 소수에 그치고 있다. 청년들에게 여전히 진입 장벽이 높은데다, 정당 역시 청년 정치인 양성에 소극적 태도를 보이는 것 등이 원인으로 꼽힌다.)

According to statistics from the National Election Commission on the 11th, the number of young preliminary candidates in their 20s and 30s registered for the local elections' super-regional chief executive races is 5, accounting for 7.4% of the total preliminary candidates (68). The number of young preliminary candidates who have thrown their hats into the ring for basic local government chief executive races is 17, which is about 1.9% of the total, and the number of young candidates running in super-regional council elections is 184, accounting for 9.2% of the total. Among candidates for basic local council elections, young candidates numbered 527, making up 10.2% of the total. Even after the final candidate registration concludes on the 15th, the proportion of young candidates is expected to be similar to that of the local elections four years ago, which were: △super-regional chief executive elections at 9.3%, △basic local government chief executive elections at 1.1%, △super-regional council elections at 8.0%, and △basic local council elections at 9.9%. <<> First, there are voices that the current election system, which requires giving up one's livelihood to enter the fray, acts as a barrier causing young people to hesitate to take on the challenge. For working youth, there is insufficient time to build name recognition while engaging in local activities, and the election costs that must be incurred from the primaries through the general election are also a burden. Ultimately, this creates a structure that is relatively advantageous for those who have money and time. A young politician active within the Democratic Party said, "There are livelihood issues in living the life of a full-time politician at a young age," and added, "There is a need to amend the Political Parties Act to allow the establishment of support groups for non-elected politicians (who can receive donations)." <<> Additionally, the closed and unpredictable nature of each political party's nomination process is another factor preventing young people from easily challenging politics. There are ongoing complaints from young politicians that it is not easy for newcomers to challenge nominations because local party chapter heads, who hold the power of nomination, sometimes support candidates they are connected to—such as those they will work closely with in the future based on personal ties, or individuals linked to their own supporters. Park Hyemin, CEO of the agency 'NewWays' that discovers young politicians, pointed out, "The problem is that the criteria for primaries and nominations are unclear and unpredictable, making it difficult for young people, who already have weak economic and social foundations, to bear the opportunity costs, such as quitting their jobs." <<> There are also persistent criticisms that, fundamentally, political parties lack systems for educating and nurturing young politicians, and that the single-member district system strengthens the two-party structure, serving as an obstacle to youth politics. <<> Lee Nae-young, a professor of political science and international relations at Korea University, stated, "If young people don't enter the National Assembly or local councils to represent the youth, there will be no one to create policies that reflect the concerns of young people," and added, "As in some European countries, it is necessary to set age and gender quotas to allow them to engage in political activities and thereby grow as politicians." <<> Reporter Jeong Hyemin jhm@hani.co.kr ( 11일 중앙선거관리위원회 통계를 보면, 지방선거 광역단체장 선거에 예비후보자로 등록한 20~30대 청년 후보자는 전체 예비후보자 수(68명)의 7.4%인 5명이다. 기초단체장 선거에 출사표를 던진 청년 예비후보자 수는 17명으로, 전체의 1.9% 수준이었고, 광역의원 선거에 출마하는 청년 후보자는 184명으로, 전체의 9.2%다. 기초의원 선거 후보자 중 청년 후보자는 527명으로, 전체의 10.2%였다. 오는 15일 최종 후보 등록이 마무리되더라도, 4년 전 지방선거 당시 청년 후보자 비율인 △광역단체장 선거 9.3% △기초단체장 선거 1.1% △광역의원 선거 8.0% △기초의원 선거 9.9% 수준이 될 것으로 보인다.)
